kept.title: One tag spelled in Cyrillic and Latin (Р32 / R32, В2 / B2); Russian layer banners on some headers
kept.detail: 'TZ Р32' with Cyrillic Р appears in coop_writer_rules.h:2, srv/coop_levels_accept.h:2, srv/coop_levels_journal.h:2, srv/coop_writer_seats.h:2. 'Р68-3' appears in srv/coop_levels_accept.h:69, srv/coop_levels_root_gen.h:2 and :26, srv/coop_levels_journal.h:215, srv/coop_levels_wire.h:1262. Latin 'R32' is used elsewhere (coop_calls.h:36, coop_mode.h:116). 'R3 В2/В3/В6' uses Cyrillic В (coop_hits.h:1, coop_protocol.h:22, :180, :525, coop_spawn.h:1, coop_upgrades.h:1, coop_validate.h:88). A grep for R32 misses half of them. Russian banners 'Ядро: без проверок режима' / 'Сервер: только ...' stand on ~20 of ~125 headers (e.g. coop_mode.h:1, srv/coop_session_srv.h:1), the rest have none, and srv/ already marks the layer.
kept.fix: If tags stay at all (see the history finding), make them ASCII. For layers use one rule: the directory is the layer. Drop the banners, or put the same English one-liner on every header.

kept.title: Board::tick re-implements Board::leading
kept.detail: Step 3 of tick (coop_transition.h:300-313) is the same oldest-claim loop as leading() (:180-195): same tie rule by since and then id.
kept.fix: Replace the block with 'uint32_t lead = 0; const bool have_lead = leading(lead);'.

kept.title: Two copies of the dwell timer state machine (campfire and base)
kept.detail: checkpoint::dwell_update (coop_checkpoint_rules.h:414-437) and checkpoint::base::step (coop_checkpoint_base_rules.h:316-345) both restart on a new key, restart when the clock goes back, restart on combat and fire once after dwell_ms. base::step only adds 'settled'.
kept.fix: Let base::Visit hold a Dwell and call dwell_update with the base key, keeping the settled branch in front.
kept.correction: The state machines match, but the proposed merge does not fit. base::Key is uint32_t (coop_checkpoint_base_rules.h:55, kNoBase = 0xffffffff), while checkpoint::Dwell::source is uint16_t with kNoSource, so base::Visit cannot hold a Dwell without truncating the key. The settled branch also runs after the new-visit and clock-back resets and clears fired (:333-338). A shared helper would have to be a template over the key type, with the settled check after the reset step. The payoff is low.

kept.title: Wire writer pushes bytes one by one; varu_size copied outside the wire module
kept.detail: Writer::u16, u32 and u64 (coop_wire.cpp:21-37) do one push_back per byte, each with a capacity check. Every snapshot field of every entity goes through them. The primitives are out-of-line in the .cpp (inlined only under LTCG, which Release-AVX has and ProfiledDX11 does not, see the tooling finding). varu_size, the byte count of Writer::varu, is copied in coop_syncstore.h:312 and srv/coop_levels_wire.h:1229.
kept.fix: Inline the primitives in coop_wire.h and write fixed-width values with resize + memcpy (static_assert little-endian). Add a static Writer::varu_size and delete the two copies. Bytes on the wire stay identical.

kept.title: ProfiledDX11 builds xrCoop without LTCG while Release-AVX uses it: profiles overstate small calls
kept.detail: xrCoop.vcxproj has WholeProgramOptimization true for Release-AVX (:94) and Release (:118), false for ProfiledDX11 (:110) and Verified (:102). The Optick config the FPS work relies on therefore measures un-inlined Writer/Reader and rule calls that the shipping build inlines.
kept.fix: Turn WholeProgramOptimization on for ProfiledDX11 (xrCoop and the other projects of that config), or note in the profiling runbook that ProfiledDX11 numbers for small functions are pessimistic.

kept.title: validate::finite = std::isfinite; finite3 copied four times; small identity functions
kept.detail: validate::finite (coop_validate.h:14-17) only returns std::isfinite(x) (3 xrGame callers). finite3 exists in coop_validate.h:19, coop_shapes.h:18, coop_checkpoint_base_rules.h:93 and coop_instrument.h:69 (x, y, z form). Identity functions: pause_key_acts(bool b) { return b; } (coop_silence_pause.h:11) and goal_of_exit(changer) { return changer; } (coop_transition.h:98). The comment on pause_key_acts gives its reason, goal_of_exit has none.
kept.fix: Use std::isfinite directly and keep validate::finite3 as the only finite3 (add an (x, y, z) overload there). Keep pause_key_acts only if naming the rule is the reason (say so in one line). Inline goal_of_exit or give it a reason.

kept.title: coop_levels_wire.h (2036 lines) holds the journal entry format next to the 0x01D0 wire layouts
kept.detail: Lines 1242-1855 (namespace journal, protocol 34) define the map server's journal entries. Lines 1856-2036 are its LevelJournal messages. The journal's logic is already in srv/coop_levels_journal.h (863 lines). The file mixes two subsystems. coop_session.cpp (3048 lines) in xrCoop is the other oversized file of this folder.
kept.fix: Move namespace journal and the LevelJournal messages into srv/coop_journal_wire.h, included by coop_levels_journal.h. Keep coop_levels_wire.h for 0x01D0-0x01DF.

kept.title: kDefaultPort 27960 defined three times with comments pointing at each other
kept.detail: coop_protocol.h:122, srv/coop_dedicated_rules.h:39 ('coop::kDefaultPort, this header is included by the engine without the protocol') and srv/coop_world_server_rules.h:570 ('dedicated::kDefaultPort').
kept.fix: Put it in a tiny dependency-free header (for example coop_ids.h or coop_ports.h) that all three include.

kept.title: Mixed style: space-indented headers, std::uint16_t vs uint16_t, bare unsigned
kept.detail: coop_attachments.h, coop_instrument.h and coop_save_policy.h are indented with 4 spaces, every other header with tabs. coop_clone_slot.h, coop_initial_rules.h, coop_item_tags.h and coop_owner_rules.h use std::uint16_t/std::uint32_t, the rest uint16_t. coop_viewers.h:95 uses 'unsigned' for ms. coop_save_policy.h has no header comment. coop_silence_pause.h:35 closes its namespace without the usual comment.
kept.fix: Run clang-format with the repo's tab style over xrCoop. Use uint16_t/uint32_t everywhere and add the one-line header comment to coop_save_policy.h. Purely mechanical.
kept.correction: The facts hold: coop_attachments.h, coop_instrument.h and coop_save_policy.h are space-indented, std::uint* appears in four headers, coop_viewers.h:95 uses unsigned, coop_save_policy.h has no header comment, and coop_silence_pause.h:35 has a bare '}'. The fix's premise does not. No .clang-format exists in anomaly-coop, engine or engine/src, and engine/src/.editorconfig declares indent_style = space, indent_size = 4 for *.h/*.cpp. The three space-indented headers follow the declared style, and the ~118 tab-indented xrCoop headers do not. Pick one style deliberately: either add an xrCoop section ([xrCoop/**] indent_style = tab) plus a .clang-format, or reindent to spaces. Only then is the reformat mechanical.

refuted.why: The bug cannot be shown. The wrap to epoch 1 is a deliberate cap stated in the comment ('each session starts at most at 127 << kEpochShift', srv/coop_xfer.h:405-406), and 'next_gen never wraps' holds inside a session. More importantly, every resume builds a fresh Ledger (srv/coop_levels_keeper.h:452-466 'xfer::Ledger fresh; ... fresh.resolve_after_load(); m_ledger = std::move(fresh)'). resolve_after_load also clears m_dead, m_live and m_loaded (:403-404), and every map server restarts with new peers. No record, tomb or holder that knows a pre-load gen of an id survives to meet a new lower gen in an ordered check: the holder's 'o.gen <= x' (coop_xfer_holder.h:620) and the world's 'past' check (coop_xfer.h:844-846) compare gens the world handed out after the load. The finding itself says the path was not traced (confidence guess).

engine-game-features.summary: Слой игровых фич движка (сюжет, выживание, торговля, диалоги, экипировка, марионетки, Lua-мост coop_script, папки srv и hostplay) в целом соблюдает правила слоёв. Красоты больше всего не хватает в одном: одни и те же мелкие помощники написаны по многу раз. Вызов Lua из C++ сделан пятью способами: 4 одинаковых traceback, 8 ручных «найти функцию под pcall» и 9 мест, которые компилируют строку Lua при каждом вызове. Регистрация таблиц coop.* повторена 17 раз, чтение аргументов из Lua существует в 12 вариантах с разными правилами, поиск объекта по id — в 13 копиях, константа kNoId — в 22. Один заметный баг: главный вызов Lua в coop_script.cpp ищет модуль вне защищённого вызова. Соседние coop_join и coop_game_settings это уже исправили, а здесь ошибка загрузки скрипта может уронить игру. Мелких багов два: реакция торговца срабатывает раньше, чем сделка точно прошла, и hud_message_n отдаёт перевод в sprintf без проверки формата. Мёртвого кода заметно: событие on_transition_vote, которое движок больше не шлёт; 7 Lua-функций, которые никто не вызывает; 5 функций srv.* при живых копиях в coop.*; остатки гибрида (host_stayed_in_world всегда false); совместимость со старыми версиями протокола, хотя другую версию и так не пускают. Больших провалов FPS нет. Лишние вызовы такие: проверка «марионетка ли это» трижды на существо за кадр со сравнением строк вместо указателей; поза лежащего игрока ставится дважды за кадр с выделением памяти под ники; список заданий пересобирается пять раз в секунду. Комментарии перегружены историей (в coop_levels_xfer.cpp 109 строк с номерами задач и датами), README в папке coop устарел и советует приём, который MODES.md запрещает. Огромные файлы survival (3450 строк), story (3575) и trade (1990) стоит разрезать по обязанностям. Всё предложенное, кроме трёх багфиксов, игрок не заметит.

kept.title: A protected Lua call from C++ is written five different ways
kept.detail: Four identical debug.traceback errfuncs: coop_script.cpp:236 lua_traceback, coop_game_settings.cpp:74 hook_traceback, coop_join.cpp:336 char_traceback, srv/coop_dedicated.cpp:165 stage_traceback. Eight hand-written 'module.fn under pcall' shims: coop_game_settings.cpp:102, coop_join.cpp:364, srv/coop_dedicated.cpp:191/305/796, coop_trade.cpp:302 and :351 (identical except the module name and the result count), coop_dialog.cpp:168. A third style compiles a Lua source string on every call with luaL_loadbuffer: coop_story.cpp:990 run_lua (kLuaGiveTask, kLuaTaskState, status), :1026 lua_note, :1055 lua_task_state_ok, coop_progress.cpp:156/194/366, coop_levels.cpp:204. call_module and send_script_callback (coop_script.cpp:283-364) repeat the same pcall-and-log body. Each copy keeps its own error budget (g_permit_errors<5, g_window_errors<5, g_verdict_errors<5, log_allowed).
kept.fix: Add one Core header coop/coop_lua_call.h: enum class LuaCall{Done,Missing,Failed}; template<P,R> LuaCall call(module, fn, push, nres, read, tag). It does the protected lookup, uses one traceback and one bounded log policy. Replace every copy with it. Turn the Lua source strings into calls of named functions: 'missing module or function -> default' becomes LuaCall::Missing.
kept.correction: Right idea, but the inventory is incomplete. There are five identical traceback errfuncs, not four: coop_sync_api.cpp:603 traceback as well. There are more hand-written pcall sites than listed: coop_requests.cpp:401/462/630/704/2878/3001/3126, coop_sound.cpp:747, coop_autosave.cpp:448-455, coop_dialog.cpp:204, coop_join.cpp:1152/1164. To keep behaviour_change=false, the shared helper must keep each site's result semantics. lua_trade_computer reports 'missing' as a successful call with NaN outputs (coop_trade.cpp:302-345). kLuaStateVerdict treats an error inside host_state_verdict as 'ok' (coop_story.cpp:1048-1053). call_module returns false on missing. Merging the error budgets changes only log volume. Risk medium is right.

kept.title: script::on_transition_vote and EngineEvent::TransitionVote are never fired
kept.detail: coop::script::on_transition_vote (coop_script.cpp:2176-2182, declared coop_script.h:175-176) has no caller in xrGame. grep for script::on_transition_vote finds nothing, and coop_join.cpp:3341 host_on_transition_vote does not call it. So the kind TransitionVote (101), its case (640-646) and its kEventNames entry (609) are dead. The Lua side already says so (coop_core_player.script:24 'no longer sent by the engine'), yet coop_script.h:47 and coop_main.script:305 still describe it as an engine callback.
kept.fix: Delete script::on_transition_vote, the TransitionVote kind, its case, its name in kEventNames and the header lines 47 and 175-176. Hand the Lua lane coop_main.on_transition_vote and coop_core_player.on_transition_vote for deletion.

kept.title: srv.* role predicates have no Lua reader while the coop.* copies stay in use
kept.detail: srv.is_dedicated, dedicated_new_world, is_map_server, is_world_server and split (srv/coop_srv_script.cpp:41-65, 141-145) have 0 uses as srv.<name> in gamedata/scripts. Only srv.journal_done (coop_srv_mode.script:238) and srv.kill_record (coop_srv_quests_far.script:815) are read. Scripts still read the Core copies registered in coop_levels.cpp:861-871, for example coop_srv_mode.script:48,50, coop_srv_dedicated.script:36,188, coop_srv_scorcher.script:97-98, coop_srv_storyline.script:133-134, coop_srv_tasks.script:81, coop_hostplay_mode.script:32, coop_reward_group.script:43 and coop_quests_core.script:43. The file's own comment (12-15) says the copies stay 'until step S8 ... once no script reads them': the move stopped half way. The same name also gives different answers: srv.is_world_server is dedicated::on()&&is_world_server() (line 58), while coop.is_world_server is true on a co-op host.
kept.fix: Finish S8: point those scripts at srv.* or at the coop_mode facade, then drop the five role entries from coop_levels.cpp roles[]. If S8 is cancelled, delete the five srv.* predicates instead. Either way, one name with one answer.
kept.correction: Mostly right, but the details of the fix are off. split is not in roles[]: it is coop.levels.split in registry[] (coop_levels.cpp:871). coop.is_world_server has no direct Lua reader at all: every 'is_world_server' in scripts is a Lua facade over coop_mode.decides_world (coop_npc_players.script:76-78, coop_mods_core.script:100-102). It can be dropped outright. The other four (is_dedicated, dedicated_new_world, is_map_server, levels.split) are read through coop.* by srv scripts, which may switch to srv.*. They are also read by Coop and Core scripts (coop_hostplay_mode.script:32, coop_quests_core.script:43, coop_reward_group.script:43), which must not name srv.* (MODES.md forbidden row 7). Those must go through the coop_mode facade, or their answer changes (coop.is_map_server = net::client()&&leads_level, coop_levels.cpp:571-575).

kept.title: Lua bindings exported through coop_script that no script calls
kept.detail: Searched gamedata/scripts and configs for .name, :name and 'name'. No caller: coop.is_map_authority (coop_levels.cpp:862; only mocked in tests/lua/test_host_as_client.lua:60), coop.levels.on_host_level (881), coop.levels.set_gate (891; its comment at 793 names coop_levels.script, which does not exist), coop.levels.gate_of (892), coop.progress.budget (coop_progress.cpp:349-350; tests/lua/test_progress_community.lua:45 only checks that it is a function), coop.autosave.slot_name (coop_autosave.cpp:718-719), coop.game.release_cvars (coop_game_settings.cpp:418; only mocked in tests/lua/test_game_settings.lua:129). coop.checkpoint.register_source/unregister_source (coop_checkpoints_lua.cpp:183-184) have no caller either, but mod_system_coop_checkpoints.ltx:11 documents them as an API for mods.
kept.fix: Remove these registrations and their l_* functions, and fix the test mocks. Keep register_source only if it is meant as a public mod API, and then say so in one API list.

kept.title: The lying pose of every avatar is applied twice per frame, with a fresh vector and nick copies
kept.detail: survival::frame (3171-3217) calls collect_players (2884-2929) every frame. It builds an xr_vector<PlayerRef> and copies every player's nick into an xr_string, only so that 3211-3213 can call avatar_pose_override per avatar. The same avatar_pose_override already runs per avatar per frame from players::drive_avatar (coop_players.cpp:395, inside remote::apply). The comment at 3207 keeps the second pass as a fallback for a frame without drive_avatar. For a down avatar, hold_pose walks 4 partitions x blends twice (2561-2569, 2626-2632). That is about 7 avatars x 60 fps = 420 string and 60 vector allocations a second for nothing in the normal case. spectate_frame (2371) does the same every frame while spectating.
kept.fix: Loop over avatar ids only (a world::avatars() view, no nicks). Mark a Pose with Device.dwFrame when it is held and return early on a second call in the same frame. The fallback stays and the duplicate work goes.

kept.title: is_remote_creature runs three times per creature per frame, with a string compare inside
kept.detail: Per creature per frame: CAI_Stalker::UpdateCL (ai_stalker.cpp:1029), then CCustomMonster::UpdateCL (CustomMonster.cpp:478) -> update_cl (coop_remote.cpp:266) -> apply (280), which checks again. apply also does g_puppets.find twice (292, 322) and world::is_player_proxy twice (301, 326). Each is_remote_creature does cast_stalker/cast_base_monster/smart_cast<CAI_Trader>, then sync::is_remote_driven (coop_sync.cpp:383-397): smart_cast<const CActor*>, xr_strcmp of the section with "coop_player_avatar" (390) where world::is_player_character compares the docked shared_str by pointer (coop_world.cpp:24-28, 77), a map find, entities::is_mirrored and smart_cast<CEntityAlive>. With 100 online creatures on a client at 60 fps that is about 18k calls a second, before the 28 stock hook sites in the monster abilities.
kept.fix: Split apply into a private drive(obj, puppet_it) that update_cl calls after its own check; the public apply keeps its check. Use world::is_player_character(obj) in is_remote_driven. Optionally answer from g_puppets membership plus !obj->Local(), which by the file's own invariant (56-57) means the object is held remote.
kept.correction: The duplicate calls are confirmed: ai_stalker.cpp:1029, then CustomMonster.cpp:478 -> update_cl (coop_remote.cpp:266) -> apply (280); g_puppets.find at 292/322; is_player_proxy at 301/326; xr_strcmp at coop_sync.cpp:390. The payoff is low, not medium. Each call is a few casts, one map find and one short strcmp, so 18k calls a second come to well under 0.1 ms per frame. The optional 'answer from g_puppets membership plus !Local()' is not safe: update_cl uses is_remote_creature to decide make_local and make_remote (266-273). Membership would make that decision circular. Keep only the private drive() split and the world::is_player_character swap.

kept.title: Hybrid leftover: the 'stayed in his world' branch is always false and cites a deleted header
kept.detail: host_frame's new-world branch keeps g_host and g_retire entries for players who 'stayed' (1938-1955) through join::host_stayed_in_world. That function is 'bool host_stayed_in_world(PeerId) { return false; }' (coop_join.cpp:3675; its comment at 3671 says 'no hybrid ... kept until their last callers ... drop them'). Its twin host_soft_stays (3673) is still passed to checkpoint::rides_with_host (coop_checkpoints.cpp:835). The comment at 1938 points at xrCoop/coop_soft_move.h, which is no longer in xrCoop.
kept.fix: Replace the branch with g_host.clear(); dropped = g_retire.size(); g_retire.clear(). Delete host_stayed_in_world and host_soft_stays (coop_join.cpp:3671-3675, coop_join.h:142-143). Pass false at coop_checkpoints.cpp:835, or drop that parameter of rides_with_host.

kept.title: The trader reacts to a deal before the transfer is known to succeed
kept.detail: host_apply fires ai_trader->callback(eTradePerformTradeOperation) (910-912) before transfer_deal (914). transfer_deal can still fail: 'BUY may then reject it' (756-761), it rolls the items back (786-798) and the deal ends as ItemGone with no money moved. The trader's scripted reaction (phrase, animation, any Lua bound to trade_perform_operation) then runs for a trade that did not happen. In single player OnPerformTrade follows the trade that was performed.
kept.fix: Fire the callback after a successful transfer_deal, next to the money change.
kept.correction: Not a stock-order bug. Stock Anomaly also fires OnPerformTrade before moving the items (ui/UIActorMenuTrade.cpp:571-574 and 634-636: OnPerformTrade, then TransferItems). The current order (coop_trade.cpp:910-914) mirrors it, and the claim that single player fires it after the trade is wrong. The only real case is a transfer_deal failure after transfer_ready re-checked every item a few lines earlier (861-864), so it is a rare race. Moving the callback after the transfer changes what any Lua bound to trade_perform_operation sees: post-trade inventories, unlike single player. No coop script binds it. If wanted, fire it only on success but keep it before set_money. Payoff low, confidence low, behaviour_change true.

kept.title: hud_message_n hands an unchecked translation to sprintf as the format
kept.detail: hud_message_n takes the translated string as the printf format (699-701: xr_sprintf(text, fmt, n)) without checking its conversions. A translation of st_coop_trade_price_buy or _sell (coop_trade.cpp:1291-1297) that contains %s, or two conversions, reads garbage. coop_survival.cpp:463-470 guards exactly this case with death::one_conversion ('a broken translation must not reach xr_sprintf with the wrong arguments'). Unlike hud_message (686), hud_message_n also writes nothing to the log.
kept.fix: Use the same one-conversion guard, with fallback to the English format, through the shared HUD text helper from the next finding. Log the fallback text as hud_message does.
kept.correction: Not a reachable bug today. Each of the three callers' shipped texts has exactly one %u: st_coop_trade_price_buy and _sell in gamedata/configs/text/eng and rus st_coop_economy.xml:202-206, and st_coop_host_silent (coop_manager.cpp:752). Only a broken third-party translation could trigger it. Treat it as hardening and consistency with tr_format (coop_survival.cpp:465-469), not a bug. Also note that logging inside hud_message_n would add one log line per second during host silence (coop_manager.cpp:748-753).

kept.title: The general HUD toast lives in the talk-lock module; translate-with-fallback is written three times
kept.detail: dialog::hud_message and hud_message_n (684-707) serve the whole layer: coop_trade.cpp (9 calls), coop_vehicles_client.cpp (7), coop_vehicles_ride.cpp (3), coop_join.cpp (5), coop_events.cpp, coop_manager.cpp and coop_requests.cpp. coop_survival.cpp:457-492 has its own tr, tr_format, feed_tr, feed_tr_s and feed_tr_d. 'Translate the id, fall back if the table lacks it' appears three times: dialog 689-690 and 699-700, survival 459-460.
kept.fix: Add a Core coop_hud_text.{h,cpp} with tr(id, fallback), tr_format(id, fallback, conv) and toast(id, fallback[, n]). Make dialog, trade, vehicles, join and survival call it.

kept.title: 'Get or create coop.<table> and set functions' is copied 17 times; two registrators
kept.detail: coop_levels.cpp:825-853 already has fill(L, name, fns). The same 15-25 lines are rewritten in coop_autosave.cpp:702, coop_checkpoints_lua.cpp:178, coop_debug.cpp:698, coop_game_settings.cpp:412, coop_initial_state.cpp:258, coop_join.cpp:3826, coop_money.cpp:1123, coop_objects.cpp:2460, coop_player_touch.cpp:365, coop_progress.cpp:330, coop_rest.cpp:810, coop_router.cpp:640, coop_script.cpp:2074, coop_sync_api.cpp:2173, coop_vehicles_client.cpp:840 (this one replaces coop.vehicle unconditionally), hostplay/coop_hostplay_steam.cpp:110 and srv/coop_srv_script.cpp:138. On top of that, coop.checkpoint, coop.rest and coop.autosave come from a second registrator (coop_checkpoints_lua.cpp:217-232), outside register_raw's list (coop_script.cpp:2088-2101). Five predicates are luabind def()s (2375-2382) while everything else is raw C.
kept.fix: Move fill() into a shared coop_lua.h (fill(L, sub, fns), plus fill_global for srv) and use it everywhere. Call checkpoints, rest and autosave from register_raw and delete coop_checkpoints_script_registrator. Register the five predicates as raw functions too, so the table has one mechanism.

kept.title: Twelve Lua argument readers with different rules for the same 'whole id'
kept.detail: arg_character (coop_checkpoints_lua.cpp:24), arg_id (coop_rest.cpp:618), arg_id (coop_script.cpp:723), arg_local_id (1784), arg_whole (coop_levels.cpp:531), arg_int with truncation (coop_money.cpp:625), arg_peer (coop_money.cpp:639, max kInvalidPeer-1), arg_peer (coop_debug.cpp:363, max kMaxPeerSlots-1), lua_whole (coop_objects.cpp:1482), arg_whole (coop_sync_api.cpp:1351), id_arg and u32_arg (srv/coop_srv_script.cpp:83, 107). They disagree: coop_script's arg_id has no fraction check, so coop.avatar_of(1.5) and coop.to_host_id(2.7) are accepted and truncated, while coop.rest.* refuses fractions. The table setters are copied too: set_field x2, set_bool, set_num and set_str in coop_script.cpp (1274, 1280, 1485, 1851, 1857), stage_text and stage_flag in srv/coop_dedicated.cpp:203-209.
kept.fix: Put arg_whole(L, i, lo, hi, out), arg_id (0..0xfffe), arg_peer and arg_text in coop_lua.h, together with set_num, set_str and set_bool. Keep money's truncating reader as a named variant, with its reason in one line.

kept.title: The 'live game object by local id' helper is copied 13 times
kept.detail: The same body (net_Find, then smart_cast<CGameObject>, then !getDestroy()) under different names: coop_survival.cpp:425 object_here, coop_checkpoint_sources.cpp:568, coop_checkpoints.cpp:115, coop_death.cpp:190 game_object, coop_events.cpp:153 find_go, coop_objects.cpp:232, coop_player_touch.cpp:88, coop_presence.cpp:228, coop_requests.cpp:181, coop_rest.cpp:128, coop_sound.cpp:150, coop_vehicles_client.cpp:154, plus coop_trade.cpp:141 find_object without the destroy check and coop_equip.cpp:367 avatar_here.
kept.fix: Put one CGameObject* object_here(u16 local_id) in coop_world.h, plus typed helpers if needed (owner_here, stalker_here). Delete the copies.

kept.title: kNoId is defined in 22 files and now_ms() in 7
kept.detail: 'constexpr u16 kNoId = 0xffff' is defined per file in 22 files (coop_story.cpp:52, coop_trade.cpp:63, coop_dialog.cpp:35, coop_remote.cpp:52, srv/coop_srv_join.cpp:48 and others; kNone in coop_player_touch.cpp:50 and coop_sync_api.cpp:50). coop_survival.cpp uses the bare literal 0xffff throughout. 'u64 now_ms() { return mgr().now_ms(); }' exists in coop_death.cpp:186, coop_dialog.cpp:84, coop_objects.cpp:220, coop_survival.cpp:420 (as now), coop_trade.cpp:139, coop_vehicles_seat.cpp:156 and coop_vehicles_state.cpp:196. This is the C++ twin of the known Lua now() copies.
kept.fix: Define one constexpr u16 kNoId in xrCoop/coop_rules.h or coop_world.h and use it instead of the bare literal. Call mgr().now_ms() directly, or add one inline coop::now_ms() in coop_manager.h.
kept.correction: The counts are slightly off. 'constexpr u16 kNoId = 0xffff' is in 20 files. 22 is the total with kNone in coop_player_touch.cpp and coop_sync_api.cpp. The 7 now_ms/now wrappers are confirmed (coop_death.cpp:186, coop_dialog.cpp:84, coop_objects.cpp:220, coop_survival.cpp:420, coop_trade.cpp:139, coop_vehicles_seat.cpp:156, coop_vehicles_state.cpp:196).

kept.title: EngineEvent keeps hand-made kinds that are queue_callback calls
kept.detail: ActorRevived and ContainerOpened rebuild what queue_callback already does. on_actor_revived (2184) is queue_callback("coop_actor_revived", {peer valid ? cb_int(peer) : cb_nil(), cb_str(section or null)}), and on_container_opened (2193) is queue_callback("coop_on_container_opened", {cb_int(peer), cb_int(id)}). For them the struct carries extra fields (text, peer, id), deliver_engine has two extra cases (647-668), and there is a name table with a static_assert (609-612). With the dead TransitionVote that makes three of the four kinds.
kept.fix: Implement both producers through queue_callback and drop the special kinds. EngineEvent then holds only name, args and t_ms.

kept.title: 'Is this a player character' is written six ways, mostly with xr_strcmp
kept.detail: world::is_player_character for CSE and for CGameObject (coop_world.cpp:75-77) compares the docked shared_str by pointer. Besides it: coop_story.cpp:53 kAvatarSection with story::is_player (164-172) and acts_as_actor (3305-3309) using xr_strcmp; coop_join.cpp:106 kProxySection (495, 551); coop_sync.cpp:390 xr_strcmp on a literal; coop_world.cpp:40 host_scan_proxies, which runs xr_strcmp over every ALife object at world start, next to its own docked string at 24-28.
kept.fix: Use world::is_player_character everywhere. Use world::avatar_section() where the section name is needed (spawn_item).

kept.title: Wire-compatibility branches for older senders that a protocol mismatch already refuses
kept.detail: The session refuses any peer with another kProtocolVersion (xrCoop/coop_session.cpp:1213), yet three places still read optional 'tails'. Equip's 'W5 tail' (coop_equip.cpp:90-133): a tail flag, an early return in write and a remaining()>0 branch in read, although capture_equip always sets e.tail = true (196). OpRevive's tail is optional in apply (coop_survival.cpp:1203) although host_on_revive_request always writes it (1594-1601). Op::Request = 1 'retired ... ignored' (coop_trade.cpp:75).
kept.fix: Read and write the tails unconditionally, keeping the 'malformed tail does not cancel the revive' tolerance. Delete Equip::tail and Op::Request; a comment 'value 1 is not reused' is enough.

kept.title: Server functions with no callers: journal_carry, host_apply_release, coop_console::is_open
kept.detail: levels::journal_carry (srv/coop_levels_xfer.cpp:1672-1693) is neither declared nor called anywhere in xrGame. levels::host_apply_release (srv/coop_levels_alife.cpp:413-424, declared in coop_levels.h:254) is only declared and defined, and its 8-hop limit is quoted by xrCoop/coop_writer_rules.h:31 and tests/test_writer_rules.cpp:191 as a reference. coop_console::is_open (srv/coop_host_console.cpp:223, ENGINE_API in coop_host_console.h:18) is called neither in xrGame nor in xrEngine; x_ray.cpp uses only open and log_line.
kept.fix: Delete all three. Re-point the kRootHops comment in coop_writer_rules.h and its test at the real walker (writer::root_of, or whatever walks the chain now).

kept.title: Torch-switch logging for an investigation still ships in the game
kept.detail: on_torch_switch (1252-1270), with its comment 1246-1251 'Live 2026-10-31, still open ... So the game says it', is a diagnostic hook in the stock CTorch. It writes up to 200 log lines per process (a function-static counter that never resets between sessions) for each torch switch of a player.
kept.fix: Close the investigation (result to the vault) and delete the hook and its stock call, or put it behind a coop.debug flag that is off by default.

kept.title: General diagnostics live in srv/, and the Core registers them by name
kept.detail: coop_ini_stats (165-186) and coop_memory_map (188-195) are diagnostics for any process; the file's own header says 'on any process, the host's too'. Yet they live in srv/, in namespace coop rather than coop::srv (21). The Core registers them by calling mapserver_stats_register_console() directly (coop_console.cpp:252), declared in coop_manager.h:156-157. MODES.md rule 7 says the Core reaches srv code only through mode() or Layer. The ServerLayer already has register_console (srv/coop_srv_mode.cpp:671) for this.
kept.fix: Move coop_ini_stats and coop_memory_map, which are generic, into coop_debug.cpp (Core). Register coop_mapserver_stats from srv::register_console and drop the declarations from coop_manager.h. Put the srv file into coop::srv.

kept.title: The two co-op Mode classes repeat about 20 identical 'nothing here' answers
kept.detail: CoopHostMode (89-123) and CoopClientMode (150-176) both spell out facts_of false, frame {}, session_over {}, online_elsewhere false, binder_may_update true, held_update {}, switched_offline {}, takes_own_ids false, own_free_id 0xffff, level nullptr, reaches true, led_elsewhere false, to_level_of false, join_from_bridge false, join_save false, level_ready true, on_world_live {}, load_text nullptr, ghost_said false, send_operator_command Unreachable and departure Disconnected. Three srv modes repeat much of the same (srv/coop_srv_mode.cpp:386-432, 505-535, 575-607). Stating every answer explicitly is a stated choice (the '§8a A8' note), but within one layer the copies are the same answer twice.
kept.fix: In hostplay, add a CoopModeBase : ModeWithAnswers that states the shared co-op answers once; the two classes override only what differs (writer_of, where, decider_of, deliver, stream, up, configure, install, deliver_links). Do the same with a ServerModeBase in srv if wanted.

kept.title: coop_survival.cpp (3453 lines) and coop_story.cpp (3575) each mix six or more responsibilities
kept.detail: coop_survival.cpp holds the camera effectors (560-685), input locking (686-782), the own-life state machine (865-1238), the host's death books and orders (1277-1673), hardcore new character and retirement (1674-1924), handlers, the C++ HUD (2682-2777, 3262-3292) and the lying poses (2561-2658). coop_story.cpp holds info portions (310), tasks (415), task targets (680-944), relations (1444-2005), map spots (2006-2360), rank and reputation (2361), hashes and resync (2490), dispatch, console and hooks (3144-3475).
kept.fix: Pure moves, no logic change. Survival: coop_survival_cam.cpp, coop_survival_hud.cpp and coop_survival_newchar.cpp, with the shared state in a coop_survival_state.h. Story: coop_story_tasks.cpp, coop_story_targets.cpp, coop_story_relations.cpp, coop_story_spots.cpp and coop_story_progress.cpp, with the outbox and apply guard in coop_story_core.cpp.

kept.title: coop_trade.cpp (1987 lines) mixes trade, containers, the trading computer, the Lua trade window and partner windows
kept.detail: One file holds the trading-computer permits (270-347), the Lua trade window bridge (348-455), the deal protocol (588-1082), search and container views (1403-1428, 1709-1845) and the partner-window closing (1845-1930).
kept.fix: Split into coop_trade.cpp (deals), coop_trade_views.cpp (container and search views, partner windows) and coop_trade_window_lua.cpp (Lua window and computer permit), behind the existing header.

kept.title: Comments carry history: task ids, review numbers, dates and builds
kept.detail: Lines matching TZ Rnn, F2 T12, 'round 1', review, dates, 'build NN', Wn or Ruling: srv/coop_levels_xfer.cpp 109, coop_survival.cpp 67, coop_script.cpp 52, coop_trade.cpp 51, coop_equip.cpp 32, srv/coop_srv_mode.cpp 24, coop_trade.h 22, coop_story.cpp 19, coop_survival.h 18. Examples: include lines tagged 'live 2026-11-08' (coop_equip.cpp:28-34) and with task ids (coop_script.cpp:15-35); every row of the binding table tagged (coop_script.cpp:2024-2072); quoted owner words with a build and date (coop_survival.cpp:2502-2505); 'review of 2026-11-25, lua_flow#1' (coop_trade.cpp:983); 'What changed against the code of build 57' (hostplay/coop_hostplay_mode.cpp:5-8).
kept.fix: Rewrite each such comment as the rule now in force and its reason. Move the 'when and who asked' part to git messages and the vault. Do it file by file with the split refactors so diffs stay readable.
kept.correction: The finding is valid, but one example is mis-cited. coop_trade.cpp:983 is 'd.lua_prices = ... // TZ R90'. The 'review of 2026-11-25, lua_flow#1' comment is at coop_trade.cpp:955, with siblings at 609, 663, 1017 and 1322. The other examples check out: coop_equip.cpp:28-34, coop_script.cpp:2024-2072, coop_survival.cpp:2501-2505, hostplay/coop_hostplay_mode.cpp:5-8, srv/coop_levels_xfer.cpp:3.

kept.title: The coop_script.h header is a changelog by waves that lists about a third of the API
kept.detail: Lines 1-50 group functions by when they were added (W3d, W4 menu, W5 C1, HUD v2 part 2, F3a T7, F4 G3-1c). They describe about 20 of the about 70 coop.* functions registered through register_raw and the sub-tables, and they still list the dead on_transition_vote callback (47).
kept.fix: Replace the block with a short contract: the threading rule (Lua may call from the worker, frame() delivers), the event RPC and the callback queue. Keep one API table per coop.* sub-table next to its registration, or generate it from the luaL_Reg arrays.

kept.title: The coop/README.md is stale and advises what MODES.md forbids
kept.detail: Line 59 tells new code to 'Check the role (mgr().is_host(), mgr().is_live_client())'. docs/MODES.md section 3 rule 4 forbids new is_host()/is_client() lines in the Core. The work-package tables (66-93) are history ('Wave 3 (2026-10-20 18:13)', 'lead (R1 review running)', agent ownership). The file never mentions the three layers, srv/, hostplay/ or mode().
kept.fix: Rewrite the README as a map of the layer: Core, hostplay and srv folders, mode()/Layer as the only way between them, the threading and messaging rules. Link docs/MODES.md and drop the ownership tables.

kept.title: coop.my_level duplicates coop.levels.my_level
kept.detail: l_own_level (coop_script.cpp:1008-1020, registered at 2036) says of itself 'the same answer as coop.levels.my_level' (coop_levels.cpp:593-597, 872). It exists so that coop_world_fx.script:129 does not have to touch coop.levels. Two functions give one answer.
kept.fix: Register levels' l_my_level under both names from a single function, or point coop_world_fx at a coop_mode facade answer and drop one of the two.

kept.title: Trade and dialog copy each other's owner helpers; trade has two identical Lua shims
kept.detail: find_owner, alive and id_of in coop_trade.cpp:143-160 are the same as coop_dialog.cpp:86-104. lua_trade_computer (coop_trade.cpp:302-316) and lua_trade_window_fn (351-366) differ only in the module name and the result count, and the same goes for their callers call_trade_computer and call_trade_window (320-346, 371-395).
kept.fix: Move the owner helpers next to object_here in coop_world.h. Replace the two shims and their callers with the shared Lua call helper.

kept.title: host_on_container runs the same visibility test twice and builds the trader-money message twice
kept.detail: For a box or corpse, 'real' (1066-1067) recomputes the rule of may_see_contents (940-950), and the line then calls may_see_contents again (1068). may_see_contents already ran at 1060 for the same view. The 'Writer w(8); write_trader_money; host_send' block is duplicated at 964-970 and 1072-1080, next to host_broadcast_trader_money (590-598).
kept.fix: Compute 'visible = may_see_contents(from, kind, id)' once and use it for both. Add one host_send_trader_money(to, trader_id).

kept.title: Story's console commands are registered from three places, one of them every frame
kept.detail: story::frame calls register_commands() every frame (3050). story::init() does the same (2988) and is called from both coop_console.cpp:260 and coop_sync.cpp:68. The g_commands_registered flag (2964) only hides the repetition.
kept.fix: Register once from coop_console.cpp's register list, like survival::register_console (coop_console.cpp:243). Delete the per-frame call and the second init.

kept.title: on_spots_remove_all sends a network message for every call, even with nothing to remove
kept.detail: The hook runs from the stock RemoveAllMapLocationsById (map_manager.cpp:189), which Lua calls through level.map_remove_all_object_spots, before the stock loop. It always queues SpotRemoveAll (3453-3456), on the host to every client and on a client as a request. It does not check whether the object has any replicable spot, which on_spot_remove does (3433-3434). Receivers then find nothing to do: the host's handler checks authors one by one (2339-2357), the client removes only replicable spots (2824-2829, 2179-2192). How often GAMMA mods call it is not measured.
kept.fix: Before queueing, collect spots().GetMapLocations(id) and send only if one of them passes spot_replicable.

kept.title: client_reconcile rebuilds a map of all tasks five times a second, then searches the list linearly again
kept.detail: Every kReconcileIntervalMs (200 ms) client_reconcile (1415-1441) allocates an xr_map<TaskKey, CGameTask*> of every local task, one node each. For every record that is due, apply_record (1266, called at 1432/1439) still runs find_task (1274), a linear scan of GetGameTasks (596-603), so a due pass is O(N^2). With 100 tasks that is 500 node allocations a second.
kept.fix: Pass the CGameTask* that client_reconcile already found into apply_record (find_task only for a fresh record). Keep a reusable sorted vector instead of a fresh map.

kept.title: The host captures every task five times a second to find changes
kept.detail: host_scan_tasks (612-649) runs every 200 ms (kTaskScanIntervalMs). For each task in GetGameTasks, finished ones included, it builds a TaskRec (capture 502-518: six shared_str copies with refcount atomics and a host_id_of lookup), finds it in g_host_sent and compares 14 fields. The task hooks (on_give_task, on_task_state, on_task_map_change) already see most changes, but Lua setters such as set_title do not go through them.
kept.fix: Keep the poll, but skip tasks whose cheap stamp (state, receive time, title pointer, map location pointer) has not changed since the last scan. Or mark tasks dirty in the stock setters and scan only those.
kept.correction: The cost is confirmed: coop_story.cpp:55 (200 ms), 612-646 scan, capture 502-518. The proposed fix is risky. A 'cheap stamp' of state, receive time, title pointer and map-location pointer misses Lua changes to descr, hint, icon, priority, map_object_id or timers. Those would then never be broadcast, which is a behaviour change. Comparing all fields is what same() already does (440-445), with pointer compares. A better fix with no behaviour change: compare the live CGameTask fields with the stored TaskRec in place, and capture only on a difference. That avoids six shared_str refcount copies and host_id_of per task. Payoff low.

kept.title: The world server copies every tunnelled packet twice
kept.detail: host_incoming (29-73), the in-filter of the world server's session, copies each Map-scope message of a player on a map server's level into TunnelMsg::packet (a std::vector, 59), then copies it again into a fresh Writer (60-61, TunnelMsg::write in xrCoop/srv/coop_levels_wire.h:982). That is two heap allocations and two copies for every such packet.
kept.fix: Add a TunnelMsg::write_raw(Writer&, peer, flags, const u8*, size) that writes the header and the bytes straight into the Writer, with the same fits() check.

kept.title: hand_light_frame looks avatars up four times a frame and retries a missing head-light every frame
kept.detail: Per avatar per frame avatar_here (net_Find plus smart_cast) runs in each of the four loops (528, 540, 554, 574). An avatar with the torch flag whose torch has no known light section makes make_head_light (499-514) run again every frame (580-581): an inventory scan with smart_cast<CTorch>, READ_IF_EXISTS and section_exist.
kept.fix: Resolve each avatar once per frame into a small array. Remember a failed head-light section per avatar (as g_lights_bad does for hand lights) until its equip changes.

kept.title: The revive-item prefix test is written three times
kept.detail: is_revive_section (507-513), find_revive_item (515-523) and revive_item_kind (3007-3013) each loop over kReviveItems (149) with strstr == c_str(). find_revive_item keeps the prefix order (medkit before stimpack), which the other two share.
kept.fix: Keep one revive_item_kind(section) returning the prefix or nullptr. Make is_revive_section a call to it, and let find_revive_item pick the item with the earliest prefix.

kept.title: Camera states are bare numbers 0/1/2/3
kept.detail: g_me.cam is compared with 1, 2 and 3 in cam_stale calls (588, 611, 645), set_cam (661-684) and camera_left_body ('g_me.cam == 2 || g_me.cam == 3', 2985-2988). The names exist only in the effector ids eff_down, eff_spectate and eff_overhead (562-564).
kept.fix: Add enum class Cam : u8 { Own, Down, Spectate, Overhead } and use it in Local and these functions.

kept.title: One C++ HUD line is never translated; every line is re-translated every frame
kept.detail: build_hud (2682-2776) runs every frame while the player is down, dead or reviving. It looks up 3-6 string-table ids and builds xr_strings each time. The reviver's line 'Reviving %s... %u%%' (2770-2772) is a hard-coded English format, unlike every other line (st_coop_* ids). A Russian player sees English when no Lua HUD is polling.
kept.fix: Add an st_coop_hud_reviving id through tr_format(.., 's'), since it has two conversions use a helper for two. Cache the translated strings per state (they change only with the language).

kept.title: Seven srv/ files lack the layer label line that the other five carry
kept.detail: srv/coop_srv_console.cpp, coop_srv_join.cpp, coop_srv_mode.cpp and coop_srv_script.cpp, and both hostplay files, start with '// Сервер: ...' or '// Кооп: ...'. srv/coop_dedicated.cpp, coop_host_console.cpp, coop_mapserver.cpp, coop_mapserver_stats.cpp, coop_levels_alife.cpp, coop_levels_xfer.cpp and coop_trunk.cpp do not, and the last three start with an 'F3a split levels' history header.
kept.fix: Put the same first line on every srv file and let tools/check_layers.py require it there as well.
kept.correction: The counts are off. Six files carry the label: four srv (coop_srv_console, coop_srv_join, coop_srv_mode, coop_srv_script) and two hostplay. Of the seven unlabelled srv files, only coop_levels_alife.cpp and coop_levels_xfer.cpp start with the 'F3a split levels' history header (line 3). coop_mapserver_stats.cpp has 'F3a T5' (line 3). coop_trunk.cpp starts directly with includes. The fix is unchanged.

kept.title: Functions of other modules are declared locally instead of in their headers
kept.detail: hostplay/coop_hostplay_mode.cpp:21-24 declares join::refuse_level_move. srv/coop_srv_console.cpp:21-24 declares extern levels::g_coop_map_servers_rev, a server setting that lives in the Core file coop_levels.cpp. srv/coop_srv_mode.cpp:84-85 declares srv::register_console and srv::register_lua, and srv/coop_dedicated.cpp:44 declares operator_dbg. A signature change then compiles in one place and fails to link or misbehaves in the other.
kept.fix: Move each declaration into the owning header (coop_join.h, a srv/coop_srv.h). Move the srv_* machine settings from coop_levels.cpp into srv/.

kept.title: File-local functions declared 'static' in a named namespace while the files use anonymous namespaces
kept.detail: coop_trade.cpp:1403 static void search_frame, coop_survival.cpp:3007 static revive_item_kind and coop_story.cpp:3338 static bool ghost_said all sit in the public namespace with 'static'. The rest of each file keeps internals in 'namespace {'.
kept.fix: Move them into the file's anonymous namespace. One style.

kept.title: The deal's duplicate check is quadratic over up to 1024 items
kept.detail: host_apply's check lambda (844-856) runs std::find over 'seen' for every id. A client may send kMaxDealItems = 1024 ids, which is about 0.5M comparisons on the host per malformed deal. Real deals are small, so the cost is only a ceiling a modified client could reach.
kept.fix: Sort a copy of the ids and check adjacent pairs, or use a small bitset or xr_set. Same result.

kept.title: The test command coop_wound_me ships in release builds
kept.detail: CCC_CoopWoundMe (2844-2860, registered at 3137), described as 'test: drop my health to zero', is available to every player in every build. It only affects the caller's own actor, but it is test tooling in the player's console.
kept.fix: Register it only with the debug or stand tools (behind coop_debug flags or a DEBUG define), or move it to coop_debug.cpp with the other test commands.

refuted.why: The lookup cannot raise in the cases the finding names. _G's __index is auto_load (xrServerEntities/script_engine.cpp:410-421). It calls process_file_if_exists, which reaches do_file. A script that fails to compile returns false (script_storage.cpp:780-787). A script that errors at load is caught by do_file's own lua_pcall (script_storage.cpp:1033-1050), which also returns false. A missing function falls through to auto_load for that name, and the no_file_exists check returns. So in practice lua_getglobal and lua_getfield in push_handler (coop_script.cpp:263-279) never throw. The 'strict _G metatable from an addon' case is speculative: such an addon would replace auto_load and break every module lookup in the game anyway. The comments in coop_join.cpp:361-364 and coop_game_settings.cpp:99-101 are review claims, not observed failures. The consistency point (one protected-call style) is already covered by finding 1.

lua-core-net.summary: Ядро Lua и слои режимов работают, но в них много повторов, лишних вызовов и следов истории. Самая дорогая вещь — обёртка маршрутизатора колбэков (coop_route guard). Она стоит на каждом вызове каждого обработчика на каждой машине и делает два вызова в движок: runs и note, причём note берёт мьютекс. Второе по цене место — фасад coop_mode: на каждый вопрос он заново опрашивает слои. Это 4–9 pcall в предикаты движка, а where/decider ещё и строят таблицу игроков заново. Таких мест вызова 1287. Оба места можно ускорить кешем на кадр, и игрок разницы не заметит. Нашла настоящие ошибки. Lua-резерв мировых событий не защищает от пересылки через мост, поэтому nimble остаётся без защиты, которую ему обещали. Запись и загрузка закрыты дважды: в coop_main и в coop_saves, причём в coop_main осталась ветка к удалённой request_quicksave. Цепочка «голосования за переход» мертва: движок её больше не вызывает. В 46+ местах проверка coop_trust.pass всё равно отбрасывает запрос, а в лог пишет «пропущено». В 8 серверных местах номера мостов сравниваются с числом вручную (0x100) вместо coop_mode.from_level. Есть и вопросы строения. coop_main смешивает шину событий с ~800 строками зеркала выброса, а coop_core_world — новости, лут мутантов, тайники и торговцев. Знание о модах (Preblowout, фантомы, FDDA, списки скриптов GAMMA) лежит в Ядре, а в Ядре 12 проверок api.is_client(). Проверка слоёв их не ловит: в правиле Lua у check_layers нет is_client(. Мелкие помощники скопированы десятками: 95 log, ~35 проверок «сессия активна», 5 копий at_first_update. В комментариях около 190 исторических пометок (даты, ревью, номера сборок, ник тестера). Остались ветки совместимости со старыми exe и хвост гибрида в coop_srv_mode.

kept.title: Обёртка каждого колбэка зовёт движок дважды (runs + note под мьютексом) на каждом вызове
kept.detail: guard() (coop_route.script:196-215) оборачивает каждый обработчик RegisterScriptCallback/AddUniqueCall/CreateTimeEvent на всех машинах, хост и одиночку включая. На каждый вызов: runs(d) (coop_router.cpp:490-498: разбор строки домена + mgr()/mode()), затем note(d,"ran") (coop_router.cpp:501-514: разбор двух строк + xrCriticalSectionGuard g_lock + counters.note). При пропуске note(d,"skipped",script,what) ещё и ищет пару (script, callback) по строкам (coop_routes.h:913-926 note_skip). Флаг rotate (строка 203) не меняется, но считается заново на каждом вызове. В GAMMA сотни обработчиков actor_on_update и npc_on_update на каждого онлайн-NPC. Оценка: ~500-1500 обёрнутых вызовов за кадр, то есть 1000-3000 вызовов в C и столько же захватов мьютекса. На клиенте к этому добавляется pcall на каждый вызов, а пропуски хост-обработчиков идут по строковой ветке. CreateTimeEvent (wrap_time_event, 379-402) на каждом вызове делает scope_now() = обход стека Lua в движке со сборкой std::string (coop_router.cpp:130-170).
kept.fix: (1) Считать ran/skipped/error в Lua: таблица счётчиков по домену и по паре script/callback, отдавать движку раз в секунду (coop.route.note_batch) или по coop_status. (2) Кешировать runs(d) на кадр (ключ device().frame, как coop_saves.input_stamp) или по эпохе маршрутов, которую движок увеличивает при смене фазы сессии. (3) Вычислять rotate один раз при создании обёртки. (4) В wrap_time_event не звать scope_now(), если для этой функции и этого кадра оно уже получено. Замерить Optick-сборкой ProfiledDX11 до и после.

kept.title: Каждый вопрос фасада coop_mode заново опрашивает слои: 4–9 pcall в движок
kept.detail: ask() → current() (coop_mode.script:178-202) на каждый вопрос вызывает pcall(layer.applies) у слоёв по очереди. hostplay.applies = is_active + is_map_server + is_dedicated + levels.split, то есть 4 pcall (coop_hostplay_mode.script:31-39). В режиме «Сервер» к ним добавляется srv.applies, ещё 2-4 (coop_srv_mode.script:53-59). Потом pcall(layer[k]): decides_world/world_server — ещё 1-3 предиката (coop_srv_mode.script:51). Итого: decides_world() стоит ~6 вызовов в C в коопе и ~9 на сервере. where()/decider() ещё и пересобирают таблицу coop.players() целиком (row(), coop_hostplay_mode.script:50-57, coop_srv_mode.script:70-77), а srv decider зовёт where и строит её второй раз (96-104). Мест вызова в скриптах 1287 (320 decides_world, 246 leads_here, 193 actor_is_player, 144 is_player_mirror, 118 writes). Пример: coop_core_hud.views() пять раз в секунду зовёт where() по каждому игроку.
kept.fix: Запоминать слой, который отвечает (результат current()), на кадр: ключ device().frame, сброс в install/uninstall/when_srv. Ответы без аргументов (decides_world, leads_here, actor_is_player, is_player_mirror, group_travels) тоже держать на кадр. Список игроков в row() держать на кадр в каждом слое. Вариант на стороне движка: один вызов coop.mode_layer() вместо четырёх предикатов.

kept.title: coop_main.reserve_world_event — только Lua-список, пересылку через мост он не перекрывает (nimble остаётся без защиты)
kept.detail: Резервов два списка. В движке: coop.reserve_world_event (coop_script.cpp:999-1006) + blocks_relay при пересылке (coop_script.cpp:435-441); его заполняет coop_world_events.script:3-28. В Lua: world_events (coop_main.script:849-860) — он отбрасывает только события с from ~= 0. Сервер мира пересылает игрокам «всем» от карты с origin = 0 (coop_script.cpp:443-453), поэтому Lua-проверка такую копию пропускает. coop_mods_xchg_nimble.script:871-875 резервирует mods.nim_held и mods.nim_done_r только через coop_main и прямо пишет, что «пересылка не должна выдать копию другого процесса за слово мира» (B-REV F7). Ни одного из этих имён нет в coop_world_events. Получается, защита, о которой говорит комментарий, не включена. bounty_t и srv.news_sample стоят в обоих списках.
kept.fix: Один список. coop_main.reserve_world_event должна звать и api.reserve_world_event. Либо перенести nimble/bounty/news_sample в coop_world_events и убрать Lua-таблицу world_events. Отдельно на стороне движка: blocks_relay должен отбрасывать и события игроков с зарезервированным именем, тогда allow_world_event в Lua не нужна.
kept.correction: Это не достижимый баг, а два списка резервов для одного дела. blocks_relay отбрасывает только события от моста (coop_script.cpp:435; coop_script.h:106-112). Широковещательное событие моста мир пересылает только игрокам (coop_script.cpp:447-453). На машине игрока held_from_wire сразу выходит по `not coop_mode.leads_here()` (coop_mods_xchg_nimble.script:618), а done_answer трогает только outgoing, который заполняет ведущий карту (607-614, 288-292). Мост nim_held и nim_done_r вообще не шлёт: их шлёт мир, через to_peer (530, 603). События игроков Lua-проверка уже отбрасывает: origin остаётся номером игрока. Итог: kind=duplicate, behaviour_change=false. Исправление прежнее: coop_main.reserve_world_event должна звать и api.reserve_world_event, либо всё перенести в coop_world_events.script.

kept.title: Запись и загрузка закрыты дважды (coop_main и coop_saves); ветка coop_main зовёт удалённую request_quicksave
kept.detail: on_before_save_input/on_before_load_input/patch_main_menu (coop_main.script:1113-1156) делают то же, что coop_saves.script:175-244 (тоже регистрирует on_before_save_input/on_before_load_input и тоже оборачивает OnButton_save_clicked/OnButton_load_clicked/OnButton_last_save). Ветка coop_main 1119-1123 зовёт coop_core_player.request_quicksave, а её нет: coop_core_player.script:25 «the client's quicksave request ... is gone», и tests/lua/test_saves.lua:412 проверяет, что её нет. На клиенте F5 даёт два сообщения в set_msg и две строки в логе: непереведённое «Co-op: only the host saves the game» из coop_main и переводимое st_coop_saves_* из coop_saves. В режиме отката (saves_open) coop_saves отправляет save_req хосту и пишет «asked», а coop_main в ту же секунду пишет «только хост сохраняет». Что увидит игрок, зависит от порядка регистрации. Пункт 2 в шапке coop_main (37-39) устарел.
kept.fix: Удалить из coop_main on_before_save_input, on_before_load_input, patch_main_menu, их регистрацию в on_game_start (1392-1393) и вызов из install_client_patches. Пункт 2 шапки переписать. Владелец этого правила — coop_saves.

kept.title: Мёртвая цепочка «голосования за переход»: движок её не вызывает
kept.detail: coop::script::on_transition_vote (coop_script.cpp:2176) никто не вызывает: поиск по engine/src/xrGame/*.cpp находит только определение и host_on_transition_vote в coop_join.cpp, у которого другое имя. Поэтому мертвы coop_main.on_transition_vote (coop_main.script:305-315), coop_core_player.on_transition_vote и состояние vote (329-337), ветка vote в accept_transition (343-349): vote всегда nil, значит EV_MOVING «core.moving» никогда не отправляется, а обработчик on_moving (356-360) с затемнением sleep_fade.ppe никогда не срабатывает. Шапка coop_core_player (23-24, 331-332) сама пишет «no longer sent by the engine». Живы эти функции только потому, что тесты зовут их напрямую (tests/lua/test_core.lua:965, test_host_as_client.lua:570).
kept.fix: Удалить on_transition_vote в обоих файлах, vote, EV_MOVING и on_moving. accept_transition свести к exec_console_cmd("coop_accept_transition") с проверкой decides_world. Удалить EventKind TransitionVote и script::on_transition_vote в движке (полоса engine). Тесты поправить.

kept.title: coop_trust.pass используется как всегда-отбрасывающая проверка: лог врёт «пропущено», а запрос отброшен
kept.detail: coop_trust.pass в режиме log возвращает true и пишет «would be refused: let through» (coop_trust.script:58-74). Для проверок, которые отбрасывают всегда, есть coop_trust.guard (76-95): комментарий там прямо говорит, что иначе лог вводит в заблуждение перед переключением на refuse. Тем не менее pass+drop сделан своими обёртками: env_request_ok (coop_main.script:843-846), news_ok (coop_core_world.script:878-881), transfer_word (coop_srv_companions.script:480-483), required (coop_srv_progress.script:45-47). И напрямую: `pass(...) or not valid then return` — coop_srv_world.script:52-53, 61-62, coop_srv_debug.script:96, 103, 119, 129, coop_debug_server.script:114, 118, coop_srv_freeplay.script:66, coop_srv_mode.script:207, 213. По всем скриптам таких мест 46 при 24 вызовах guard.
kept.fix: Заменить на coop_trust.guard(name, ok, fmt, ...) и удалить 4 локальные обёртки. Отбрасывание то же, меняется только текст лога и строка статуса [guard].
kept.correction: Деталь неверна. Для проверок, которые отбрасывают всегда, в проекте уже есть второй приём: строка `<name> = refuse` в configs/mod_system_coop_trust.ltx (её шапка: «refuse only makes the log say what happens»). Так покрыты progress_*, level_request_*, task_*_sender и другие. Значит, лог не врёт для coop_srv_progress.required (45-47), coop_srv_mode.script:207, 213 (level_request_*) и coop_srv_tasks. Врёт он только для имён без строки refuse: env_* (coop_main.script:843-846, 858, 868; coop_srv_world.script:52, 61), debug_* (coop_srv_debug.script:96, 103, 119, 129; coop_debug_server.script:114, 118), freeplay OFFER (coop_srv_freeplay.script:66), а также news и companions. Настоящая находка — «два способа сказать одно и то же» (guard против pass + ltx refuse). При переходе на guard строки refuse в ltx станут мёртвыми, а в coop_status вместо [refuse] будет [guard]. behaviour_change=false верно.

kept.title: Номера мостов сравниваются с 0x100 вручную вместо coop_mode.from_level; правило шире, чем в движке
kept.detail: В движке мост — это 0x101..0x107 (coop_mapserver_rules.h:37-40, is_bridge: peer > kBridgeBase && peer <= kBridgeBase + kMaxBridges). Серверный Lua проверяет `from < 0x100 then return` (coop_srv_quests_far.script:911, 1025, 1094, 1126; coop_srv_levels_share.script:142; coop_srv_tasks.script:116), то есть за мост принимает 0x100 и всё от 0x108 и выше. coop_srv_freeplay.script:64 жёстко пишет 0x100 < from <= 0x107. coop_srv_tasks 245/321/378 проверяет 0x100 и следом from_level — двойная проверка. Готовый вопрос coop_mode.from_level(from) (coop_mode.script:288-292 → coop_srv_mode.script:111-120) сверяет с живым списком map_servers().
kept.fix: Везде звать coop_mode.from_level(from). Если нужен номер карты, брать bridge из levels.map_servers(). Числа 0x100/0x107 убрать из Lua.
kept.correction: Это не баг и не изменение поведения. Других пиров с номером ≥0x100, кроме мостов 0x101..0x107, нет: слоты игроков < kBridgeBase (static_assert в engine/src/xrCoop/srv/coop_mapserver_rules.h:37-40; путь из находки неверен, файл лежит в xrCoop/srv/). Поэтому более широкая проверка `from < 0x100` на деле принимает те же номера. Это дубль правила движка магическими числами в слое Сервер (coop_srv_quests_far.script:911, 1025, 1094, 1126; coop_srv_levels_share.script:142; coop_srv_tasks.script:116, 245, 321, 378; coop_srv_freeplay.script:64). behaviour_change=false, kind=duplicate. Учесть, что coop_mode.from_level требует ещё is_active и dedicated (coop_srv_mode.script:111-120); для обработчиков в сессии это то же самое.

kept.title: «Сервер мира / сервер карты / split» определены в слое Сервер пятью разными способами
kept.detail: coop_srv_mode: world_server = dedicated or (is_host and not map_server) (51), split через applies. coop_srv_levels_brain.script:56-67: свои split/map_server/world_server = api.is_host(). coop_srv_quests_far.script:69-75 и coop_srv_levels_tables.script:27-33: qc().is_host() = active() and api.is_host() (coop_quests_core.script:41). coop_srv_levels_share.script:35, 141: q.is_host(). coop_srv_scorcher/storyline: свои active(). До начала сессии на сервере мира is_host ложно (coop_srv_mode.script:12-13), значит эти варианты расходятся с фасадом именно в ту минуту, когда when_srv уже работает.
kept.fix: В слое Сервер спрашивать coop_mode.decides_world()/leads_here()/is_player_mirror(). Либо сделать один серверный помощник (например coop_srv_roles: world_server, map_server, split) и звать только его. Локальные копии удалить.
kept.correction: Дубли подтверждены (coop_srv_levels_brain.script:56-67, coop_srv_quests_far.script:69-75, coop_srv_levels_tables.script:27-33, coop_quests_core.script:41, coop_srv_scorcher.script:95, coop_srv_storyline.script:130). Но behaviour_change=false здесь неверно. Как говорит сама находка, фасад (srv decides_world = dedicated(), coop_srv_mode.script:51) истинен на сервере мира до начала сессии, а локальные is_host() там ложны. Если просто заменить их на coop_mode.decides_world()/leads_here(), их тики и обработчики начнут работать до начала сессии. Безопасный путь — один серверный помощник с той же семантикой «в сессии и сервер мира» (например coop_srv_roles); поведение каждой точки при замене на фасад проверять отдельно. risk=medium.

kept.title: Ветки совместимости со старыми exe, хотя скрипты и exe идут одной сборкой
kept.detail: tools/package.ps1:107-111 не даёт собрать пакет с exe другой сборки, если не просить специально. При этом в полосе: role(new_name, old_name) с запасными is_client/is_active (coop_core_player.script:61-80); предупреждение «exe до сборки 55» в apply_boosters (198-204); шапка про ключ _v2 и сборку 55 (15-18); live() «a build without coop.is_player()» (coop_core_hud.script:68-80); host_badge «an older engine has no field» (coop_core_hud.script:88-93, coop_core_chat.script:74-78); parse_slot «an exe without it has only the old ring» (coop_saves.script:297-310); SOURCES со старыми именами и «bare boolean» (coop_debug_client.script:72-88).
kept.fix: Задать минимальную сборку exe, которую может нести пакет, и удалить ветки для более старых. Запасной вариант оставлять только там, где сборка «только скрипты» реально идёт с прошлым exe, и подписать причину.
kept.correction: Посылка неверна. tools/package.ps1:110-111 прямо разрешает пакет «только скрипты» с exe другой сборки (-EngineBuild <n>, «pack another build's exe on purpose»). Значит, скрипты и exe не обязаны идти одной сборкой. Запасные ветки (coop_core_player.script:65-80, 198-204; coop_core_hud.script:68-93; coop_core_chat.script:74-78; coop_saves.script:297-310; coop_debug_client.script:72-88) можно удалять только после того, как задана минимальная сборка exe и package.ps1 её проверяет. Поведение не меняется только для exe не старше этой сборки.

kept.fix: Оставить один вход: coop_mode.share_up/share_down (и coop_quests_core.add_death_listener). Пробросы в coop_srv_levels_share и coop_srv_quests_far удалить, вызовы поправить.

kept.title: «Объявить колбэк, если ещё не объявлен» — три реализации
kept.detail: coop_main.ensure_callback (218-228: callback_exists через shim + AddScriptCallback); coop_route.declare (coop_route.script:522-530: то же самое, с объяснением про предупреждения axr_main); ручная запасная ветка в coop_srv_task_audience.script:475-479; coop_srv_mode.script:289-290 зовёт add("coop_op_done") без проверки.
kept.fix: Везде coop_route.declare(name). ensure_callback удалить или свести к нему.

kept.title: handlers_of / handlers_from / domain_handlers повторяют один и тот же проход и сортировку
kept.detail: Все три (491-516, 535-557, 561-584) берут intercepts()[callback], собирают {fn, v} по своему условию, сортируют по v и разворачивают в список. Разница только в условии отбора (скрипт по маршруту, по источнику, по домену).
kept.fix: Один локальный sorted_handlers(callback, pick), где pick(key, origin) → fn или nil; три публичные функции становятся однострочниками.

kept.title: Комментарий handler_domain противоречит guard (будто бы хвостовой вызов на хосте)
kept.detail: 597-598: «On the host a guard leaves the stack by a tail call and the handler stays on it». А guard (208-210) делает наоборот: «no tail call: this wrapper stays on the stack while the handler runs (its scope, R32 W2a)» и return pass(f(...)).
kept.fix: Переписать: handler_domain даёт домен функции, зарегистрированной как обработчик (coop_core_world.made_by смотрит его по стеку).

kept.title: Метки слоя: в Ядре их нет, в Сервере — пять форм и два языка
kept.detail: MODES.md:46 требует, чтобы первая строка файла Ядра была «-- Ядро: без проверок режима (docs/MODES.md)». В полосе она есть только у coop_mode. У coop_main, coop_route, coop_sync, coop_trust, coop_saves, coop_core_*, coop_debug_* первая строка «--[[» или своя. В слое Сервер встречаются «-- Server (srv):», «-- Сервер (srv):», «-- Server:», «-- Server layer:», «-- Server faction changes:», причём комментарии кода везде английские, а первая строка у части файлов русская.
kept.fix: Одна форма первой строки на слой («-- Ядро: …», «-- Кооп (hostplay): …», «-- Сервер (srv): …»), дальше одним языком. Можно проверять в check_layers.

kept.title: Список игроков views() строится 7 раз в секунду вместо 5
kept.detail: update_spots (1113-1123) раз в SPOTS_MS = 200 мс вызывает views(tg). Панель раз в PANEL_MS = 500 мс строит его ещё раз через shared_views(tg, true) (1013). Каждый views() — это players() плюс на каждого игрока coop_mode.where (цепочка фасада + ещё один players(), см. находку про фасад), coop_mode.hook для away, pcall character_icon.
kept.fix: В update_spots взять shared_views(tg, true): метки, панель и табло перехода будут читать одну 5-Гц выборку. Данные те же или свежее.
kept.correction: Подсчёт верен: views 5 раз/с из update_spots (coop_core_hud.script:1113-1115, SPOTS_MS=200) плюс 2 раза/с из панели через shared_views(tg, true) (1013, PANEL_MS=500). Но предложенного исправления мало. Панель передаёт fresh=true, поэтому список всё равно строится 7 раз/с, даже если update_spots перейдёт на shared_views(tg, true). Нужно и в UICoopParty:Refresh (1013) читать shared_views(tg) без fresh. Тогда панель покажет выборку возрастом до 200 мс, а не построенную в момент обновления: на глаз незаметно, но «данные те же или свежее» верно только для табло. place_far список не меняет (342-352), делить его безопасно.

kept.title: Проверки роли каждый кадр до ограничителя по времени
kept.detail: coop_core_player.actor_on_update (365-383) каждый кадр зовёт api.is_active, live() (is_active + pcall is_player + is_live), иногда coop_mode.decides_world и is_mirror() (ещё 2 вызова), а работа идёт раз в 1000 мс. coop_core_hud.actor_on_update (1125-1130): live() каждый кадр. coop_main.actor_on_update (1313-1315): api.is_client() и context_tick каждый кадр, хотя остальное раз в 250 мс. coop_saves.actor_on_update (285-292): pcall(api.is_active) каждый кадр только ради конца сессии.
kept.fix: Сначала ограничитель по времени, потом проверки. client_mode в coop_main читать в on_before_* напрямую. coop_saves — подписаться на конец сессии (например on_session_end или coop_world_*) вместо опроса каждый кадр.
kept.correction: Совет «сначала ограничитель по времени» в двух местах меняет поведение или ломает логику. coop_core_player.actor_on_update (365-383): client_after_load должен выполниться в первый кадр, когда есть db.actor; если поставить проверку ROSTER_MS (1000 мс) раньше, состояние игрока после загрузки придёт до 1 с позже. Правильно — переставить проверки: `not after_load_done and db.actor and is_mirror()`. coop_core_hud.actor_on_update (1125-1150): live() каждый кадр нужен, потому что party_on и пульсация меток (spots_down) работают каждый кадр. Его можно кешировать, но не убирать за ограничитель. coop_main (1313-1316): context_tick и так сначала сверяет время; is_client каждый кадр нужен только client_mode, а он уйдёт вместе с находкой 3. coop_saves (285-292): один вызов движка за кадр. Выигрыш везде ничтожный.

kept.title: shim() создаёт замыкание и делает pcall на каждое входящее событие и чат
kept.detail: shim() (147-150) = pcall(function() return coop_route end) — новое замыкание на каждый вызов. on_event (231-248) → callback_exists → get_intercepts → shim → pcall(r.intercepts), то есть 2 pcall и замыкание на каждое событие. on_chat и script_of — так же. Модуль coop_route гарантированно загружен: coop_main ставит его при загрузке (1430-1433).
kept.fix: Один раз при загрузке: local route = rawget(_G, "coop_route") or coop_route. callback_exists читать прямо из route.intercepts() (результат кешируется внутри).

kept.title: «Своя» строка чата определяется по нику, хотя движок передаёт отправителя
kept.detail: on_line (196-208): kind = (me and nick == me) and "self". При одинаковых никах строки другого игрока рисуются моим цветом, без звука и без подмены «World» (sender_of). coop_main.on_chat получает from — peer отправителя (253-256).
kept.fix: kind = (from ~= nil and from == api.self_id()) and "self" or "other"; по нику сравнивать, только если from нет.

kept.title: Три оператора в одной строке и хвостовой комментарий «W10»
kept.detail: `local ok_cb, err_cb = pcall(function() return coop_client_binders.install() end) if not ok_cb then report_error(...) end -- W10: the other object binders` — единственное такое место в файле, рядом в install_client_patches тот же приём записан в 3 строки.
kept.fix: Разбить, как соседние вызовы. Лучше — одна локальная try(what, f) для пяти одинаковых pcall+report_error в install_client_patches/on_game_start.

kept.title: add_level_handler заворачивает обработчик в лишнее замыкание с проверкой api
kept.detail: run(payload, from) (196-198) проверяет `if api` и выбрасывает третий аргумент relayed. События приходят только от движка, то есть api есть всегда. Запасной add_event_handler (201) нужен только тестовой обвязке без coop_mode (tests/lua/test_srv_world.lua:80).
kept.fix: Регистрировать func напрямую через coop_mode.on_level_request(name, func). Если отбрасывать relayed — так и сказать в комментарии. Тесты — загружать coop_mode.
kept.correction: Причина обёртки написана: coop_main.script:193 «Keep the original two arguments to the handler». Утверждение «так и сказать в комментарии» неверно. Мёртвая часть только одна — проверка `if api` (события приходят только от движка). Отрезание relayed сейчас ничего не защищает: все 6 регистраций берут два аргумента (coop_core_world.script:1374/1376/1380 -> on_mloot_open, on_mloot_close, host_on_trader_req; coop_economy_core.script:210 и coop_quests_core.script:283 сами оборачивают в function(payload, from)). Регистрировать напрямую безопасно, но выигрыш косметический.

kept.title: Глобал env_own_cover вместо предварительного объявления local
kept.detail: client_env_tick (777) зовёт pcall(env_own_cover), а функция own_cover объявлена ниже (1025). Чтобы до неё дотянуться, сделан глобал модуля env_own_cover = own_cover (1033): теперь coop_main.env_own_cover видят все скрипты.
