kept.title: Таблица env_host работает и на клиенте, и на сервере карты — имя не то
kept.detail: env_host (321) держит serial/kill_sent/cover_rep/sample_cover. Но client_env_tick зовёт env_host.sample_cover (768, 813, 830, 836), а mirror_start_surge увеличивает env_host.serial на сервере карты (627). Имя говорит «хост», а таблица — это «тот, кто судит игроков на этой карте».
kept.fix: Переименовать в env_judge (или разделить на часть решающего мир и часть ведущего карту) при выносе в coop_env.

kept.title: Тестовые входы рассыпаны глобалами по боевым файлам в разных стилях
kept.detail: _rotate_turn (coop_route.script:154), _tick/_orders_clear/_stats/_names_of (coop_srv_quests_far.script:1165-1168), _targets/_tick (coop_srv_levels_brain.script:300-301), _tick (coop_srv_levels_share.script:201), _stats/_reset (coop_srv_scorcher.script:399-400), _heal_once (coop_srv_tasks.script:176), reset_for_test (coop_trust.script:120).
kept.fix: Один стиль: таблица _test = { tick = …, stats = … } в конце файла с комментарием «только тесты», либо доступ из тестовой обвязки через debug.getupvalue.
kept.correction: _heal_once — не тестовый вход: его зовёт боевой код (coop_srv_tasks.script:419), а тесты используют его тоже. Это рабочая функция с именем как у тестовой точки; её нужно переименовать, а не переносить в таблицу _test. Остальные подтверждены как тестовые: coop_route.script:154; coop_srv_quests_far.script:1165-1168; coop_srv_levels_brain.script:300-301; coop_srv_levels_share.script:201; coop_srv_scorcher.script:399-400; coop_trust.script:120.

kept.title: Пустой __finalize и проброс hold → hold_autosaves
kept.detail: UICoopRestore:__finalize() пустой (476-477). function hold(on) hold_autosaves(on) end (420-422) — проброс один в один (возможно, уже есть в известном списке из 43 пробросов).
kept.fix: __finalize удалить. hold_autosaves переименовать в публичную hold, вызовы внутри файла поправить.

kept.title: script_rule портит счётчики маршрутизатора фиктивными вызовами route.of
kept.detail: Для каждого нового скрипта, который присылает новость, script_rule (311-319) зовёт route.of("npc_on_update", f) и route.of("actor_on_update", f). l_of с непустым callback увеличивает g.routed[d] и кладёт пару в кеш маршрутов (coop_router.cpp:476-481). В coop_status растёт число «routed», а в кеше появляются пары (callback, script), которых никто не регистрировал.
kept.fix: Спрашивать правило скрипта вызовом без побочных эффектов: новый coop.route.rule_of(script) в движке или флаг «не считать» у route.of.

kept.title: Проверка вида цели в отладке написана дважды
kept.detail: coop_debug_server.kind_ok (132-136: npc = IsStalker or IsMonster, stalker = IsStalker) и coop_debug_cmds npc_ok/stalker_ok (coop_debug_cmds.script:220-221) — одно и то же. LAST_PLAYER_PEER = 16 задан и в coop_debug_server.script:46, и в coop_srv_debug.script:9, а рядом есть coop_debug_cmds.max_peer() (159).
kept.fix: coop_debug_server звать coop_debug_cmds.npc_ok/stalker_ok (сделать их публичными) и max_peer(); константы удалить.
kept.correction: Дубль kind_ok / npc_ok+stalker_ok подтверждён (coop_debug_server.script:131-136, coop_debug_cmds.script:220-221). Замена LAST_PLAYER_PEER на coop_debug_cmds.max_peer() неверна и меняет поведение. LAST_PLAYER_PEER = 16 — это абсолютный предел движка (kMaxPeerSlots-1, coop_debug_server.script:46, coop_srv_debug.script:9). max_peer() — места текущей сессии: 7 в коопе и вне сессии, иначе session_info().max_players (coop_debug_cmds.script:155-162). Граница проверки стала бы уже. Правильно — одна общая константа (или значение из движка), а не max_peer().

lua-items-ui.summary: Код этой части (экономика, предметы, торговля, HUD, меню, отладочное окно — 52 файла, около 28 тыс. строк) аккуратный: случайных глобалов и неиспользуемых локалов нет, всё внешнее обёрнуто в pcall. Главная беда в повторах. Один и тот же набор мелких функций HUD (put/show/tint/text_set/metrics/argb/hud_visible/live/tr/peer_color/nick_of) скопирован в 4–8 файлов. Механика «удержи F» целиком повторена в coop_hud_arena и coop_hud_transition. Есть 14 версий tr() с разным поведением, около 10 загрузчиков модулей и два разных меню выбора суммы для «отдать деньги». Мёртвый код: модуль coop_economy_intent.script (201 строка) в игре никто не вызывает, его вызывают только тесты. Ещё не используются veto_if_ungathered, counters, blocks и is_registered. Нарушение «ядро не знает модов»: coop_economy_mdata держит список из 7 модов GAMMA, файлы coop_credit_*, coop_pda_marks_local, coop_loot_claim и coop_trader_reputation по сути переходники модов, но лежат не в coop_mods_*. coop_trade_window (с меткой «Ядро») зовёт coop_mods_wpo_holder по имени. Реальная лишняя работа сидит в экономике, а не в HUD. coop_economy_mdata каждый кадр вызывает coop.players() только ради подсчёта игроков. Для каждого предмета он строит полный список игроков с позициями. Раз в секунду сериализует каждую вещь инвентаря по каждому ключу, даже пустые значения. Всё это чинится без изменения поведения. Весь HUD по замеру 2026-11-13 стоит 0,205 мс на кадр, поэтому правки HUD — для красоты и меньшей нагрузки на сборщик мусора, а не ради FPS. Комментарии часто пересказывают историю (даты, R92, «review of 2026-11-25», «was ~0.6»), а метка «-- Ядро: …» по-русски стоит в начале английских файлов. Явных ошибок в игровой логике не нашла. Есть устаревшие или противоречивые комментарии (set_revive «никто не зовёт», «ходьба при открытом окне») и мелкий крайний случай в избранном отладочного окна.

kept.title: Whole module coop_economy_intent is unused in the game (tests only)
kept.detail: The header (lines 9-23) offers register/request/requester_avatar/host_bridge/open_box_when_online/linked_box_resolver to addon patches. No production script calls any of them: grep for coop_economy_intent across gamedata/scripts finds only coop_economy_core.script:523-524 (the MODULES list for print_status). engine/src/xrGame/coop, engine/src/xrCoop and configs never name it. The only verb ever registered is in tests/lua/test_economy.lua:1487 ('hf:workshop_stash'). The real Hideout Furniture adapter (coop_mods_hf.script:229,659) handles workshop stashes without it. Even so, on_game_start still installs a level handler for 'economy.intent' (line 200).
kept.fix: Delete coop_economy_intent.script, drop it from coop_economy_core MODULES (line 523-524) and remove the test block in tests/lua/test_economy.lua (~1480-1510). Note the removal in the vault (it was the P7 design).

kept.title: Every frame calls coop.players() just to count other players
kept.detail: actor_on_update (1777) runs every frame on every machine in a session. Line 1802 calls nobody_to_tell() (303-305) -> core.others_count() (coop_economy_core.script:303-312) -> pcall(api.players), which has the engine build a Lua table of all players every frame. Its result is only used under time gates: item_poll every 1000 ms (1807), pmd_poll every 15 s (1816), wmd_poll every 2 s (1827). The two flag resets at 1803-1804 are idempotent, because only a poll sets them back. Also every frame: m_data() (90-94) creates a closure for pcall at 1779, just to notice a new alife_storage state.
kept.fix: Compute nobody_to_tell() only when one of the three gates is due (keep the flag reset there). For clone_storage, call asm.get_state without the per-call closure (keep the module in a local), or reset on the load_state callback. Same result, no per-frame engine table.

kept.title: item_instance() builds the full player list (positions, object lookups) for every item
kept.detail: item_instance(id) loops over core.players() (coop_economy_core.script:268-289). That function calls api.players(), level.object_by_id for each avatar, copies positions and may ask alife for offline ones, all to compare avatar_id. It runs in per-item loops: item_poll 683 (each changed rider of each inventory item), carry 1099/1111, se queue 339, 434, se_retry 595, and in log lines. coop_economy_world.script:178 calls core.players() once per taken roll in bake_taken, and core.player(peer)/nick_of(peer) (coop_economy_core 291-300) do the same just to return one row or one nick.
kept.fix: Add a cheap core.avatar_peer(id) that walks pcall(api.players) and compares avatar_id only (optionally cached per time_global() tick). Let player(peer) build only the matching row. item_instance and bake_taken use them. The result is the same.

kept.title: item_poll serialises every inventory item x every rider key each second, nil included
kept.detail: item_poll (662) runs every ITEM_POLL_MS = 1000 (63) on every machine with riders. For each item in db.actor's inventory and each of the 7+ keys (778-791, plus adapters) it calls core.pack(value) at 680. pack (coop_economy_core 439-443) allocates an out table and runs table.concat even when value is nil, which gives "_" (pack_into 393-394). A GAMMA backpack with ~200 items gives ~1500+ table allocations and concats per second, for values that are almost always nil.
kept.fix: local packed = value == nil and "_" or core.pack(value) (exactly what pack(nil) returns). Optionally skip a key whose m_data table is absent. The output order and contents stay the same.
kept.correction: The main fix is right and exact: pack(nil) is '_' (coop_economy_core 393-394, 439-443), so `value == nil and '_' or core.pack(value)` changes nothing. The optional 'skip a key whose m_data table is absent' changes behaviour. When a whole rider table disappears, item_poll today sends a removal for every item whose base was not '_' (676-683). Skipping the key would lose those removals, so any skip must still compare the item's base with '_'. Payoff is closer to low: it runs once per second, and only when someone is there to tell.

kept.title: The HUD widget kit is copied in 4 files (and partly in 4 more)
kept.detail: The same helpers are defined over and over. vec2: core_hud 524, revive 322, transition 497 (arena inlines vector2():set at 290-296). el: core_hud 529, revive 327, transition 502, arena 288. put: core_hud 533, revive 331, transition 506, arena 290. show: core_hud 544, revive 342, transition 517, arena 301, compass 450, ping 400. tint: core_hud 548, revive 350, transition 525, arena 309. new_text/text_set/text_place/text_show: revive 359-372, transition 534-560, arena 317-330. metrics(): core_hud 518, revive 528, transition 619, arena 389. argb: core_hud 387, compass 440, revive 265, transition 228, arena 284, netgraph 213, coop_ui 59, coop_ui_kit 35, coop_allies 121. Also hud_visible x8, peer_color (arena 146, revive 221, transition 186), my_peer (arena 180, revive 246, transition 173), the 500 ms cached nick_of (arena 155 and transition 196 byte-identical), layout() (core_hud 482, arena 88, compass 122, markers 146, netgraph 82) and format_distance (compass 419, ping 364). Semantics drift between copies: show() uses e:IsShown() in core_hud/compass/ping and a cached t.shown in revive/transition/arena, and tint takes (t,c) in core_hud but (t,a,rgb) elsewhere.
kept.fix: Create one Core file coop_hud_kit.script (no mode checks) holding these helpers, with one reused vector2 like compass's self.v2. Each HUD file does local K = coop_hud_kit. Pick one show() rule (cached flag) and one tint signature, and keep the tests' .e/.x/.y fields.

kept.title: The 'hold the use key' state machine is duplicated in arena and transition HUDs
kept.detail: coop_hud_arena 506-646 and coop_hud_transition 792-1005 each carry: a key table {down, events_at, seen, latched}; drop_hold (latch while down); the step_hold head that drops a hold whose key events stopped (HOLD_GAP_MS); a hidden_at grace while the HUD is hidden; start_hold guards; on_key_press/on_key_hold/on_key_release; is_use_key via pcall(dik_to_bind) == kUSE; alpha_step (arena 345, transition 562); and hold_fraction (arena 350, transition 569). They differ only in what fires (arena: A.start_pressed, transition: exec_console_cmd(COMMANDS[kind])) and in the guard predicate. Both also register on_key_hold and each runs pcall(dik_to_bind) for every held key every frame.
kept.fix: Extract coop_hud_hold.script: new(opts{kinds, ms_of(kind), may_start(), on_fire(kind)}) returning {press, hold, release, step(tg, ok), fraction(tg, kind)}. Register the key callbacks once in it and let both HUDs ask it.

kept.title: Core economy hard-codes 7 GAMMA mods' item riders and 2 mods' world keys
kept.detail: declare_builtin_item_keys (778-791) names item_exo_device, z_mark_switch, scripted_canted_irons, magnifier_switch, meat_spoiling, mag_pouches and speed_loaders. world_keys at 1262 holds player_created_stashes and workshop_stashes. At the same time adapters declare their own keys: coop_mods_mags.script:173-174 (mags_storage) and coop_mods_item_state.script:1196, and register_world_key exists (1271). So there are two ways to register a rider, and the Core economy knows mods (P12/P106 for Lua).
kept.fix: Move each entry into its mod's adapter as em.declare_item_key / register_world_key (create coop_mods_<mod> files where none exist). Delete declare_builtin_item_keys and empty the builtin world_keys list.
kept.correction: Only half the world-key part holds. player_created_stashes is a stock Anomaly key (temp\anomaly_unpack\...\item_backpack.script:27-31, the backpack stash), so it belongs in Core. Only workshop_stashes is a mod key (Hideout Furniture). The seven item riders (778-791) are mod keys, as stated. Moving them must keep the same detection (rawget(_G,mod) or core.mod(mod)) and declare them before the first item_poll; the declaration order changes only the order of entries in a batch.

kept.title: Mod adapters live outside coop_mods_*: some files are marked Core but name GAMMA mods
kept.detail: These files are marked '-- Ядро: без проверок режима' or named as Core, yet adapt specific GAMMA mods. coop_credit_events (npe 72-73, gameplay_silent_kills 112, stealth_kill_detection 152, ui_enemy_health 186, smr_loot 225). coop_credit_loot (haru_skills 83, death_manager 84/215, outfit_drop_mcm 217). coop_credit_misc (xr_eat_medkit 138, nimbleclearinventory 165). coop_pda_marks_local (zzz_sim_squad_scripted_milpda 179, item_milpda 181/252, sim_squad_warfare 181, ish_kill_tracker 250, utils_catspaw_taskmonitor 253). coop_loot_claim replaces grok_loot_claim (header 4-6, tr(mod_id, own_id) 422). coop_trader_reputation rewrites heavy_pockets_functor supply condlists (137-160) by wrapping xr_logic.parse_condlist globally (180-189). Under P12 an adapter is one coop_mods_<mod> file. Here the layer marker says the opposite, and check_layers cannot see mod knowledge.
kept.fix: Rename or move each into coop_mods_<mod>.script. Core keeps only the hook points (credit API in coop_credit.script, a supplies-rewrite hook in trader reputation). Remove the 'Ядро' marker from what stays mod-specific.
kept.correction: The file list mixes stock Anomaly scripts with mods. gameplay_silent_kills, ui_enemy_health, death_manager, xr_eat_medkit and sim_squad_warfare are stock (present in temp\anomaly_unpack\scripts_out\scripts), and glue to stock scripts rightly stays in Core. The mod knowledge is: npe/npe_director and stealth_kill_detection (credit_events 72-73, 152), smr_loot strings (219), haru_skills and outfit_drop_mcm (credit_loot 83, 206, 217), nimbleclearinventory (credit_misc 165), item_milpda, zzz_sim_squad_scripted_milpda, ish_kill_tracker and utils_catspaw_taskmonitor (pda_marks_local 179-181, 250-253), grok_loot_claim (loot_claim) and heavy_pockets_functor (trader_reputation rewrite_supplies 137-157; the parse_condlist wrap is at 189-196, not 180-189). coop_loot_claim and coop_trader_reputation carry no 'Ядро' marker.

kept.title: Core trade window calls the WPO adapter by name
kept.detail: The file is marked Core (line 1). formula() at 238-243 does module_of("coop_mods_wpo_holder") and calls holder.install() on every price computation, and the header (25-27, 56) documents this mod dependency. This is the Lua twin of the known engine G1/G2 issue (the engine calling coop_mods_* by name).
kept.fix: Give coop_trade_window a hook list (before_pricing(fn)). coop_mods_wpo_holder registers itself at its on_game_start. formula() runs the registered hooks and never names a mod.

kept.title: Two separate 'give money' amount menus; coop_ui mixes three features
kept.detail: coop_economy_money builds the context-menu path 'Give money to X...' -> amounts (AMOUNTS at 44, list built at 551-571, 'All (%s)', item_props:Reset, coop_eco_GiveAmount). coop_ui builds the inventory envelope button with its own GIVE_AMOUNTS (377) and its own amounts_menu/on_money_button (428-476) and coop_ui_GiveAmount (515). Both use the same string ids (st_coop_eco_give_money_to, st_coop_eco_money_all). coop_ui.script also holds the generic message window and the rejected/session-end explanations (header 1-18), so it mixes the session UI with economy UI.
kept.fix: Expose one coop_economy_money.open_amounts(ui, peer) and call it from both entry points. Move the envelope button (coop_ui 375-519) into coop_economy_money (or coop_economy_give), so coop_ui keeps only message windows.

kept.title: Nine versions of the HUD 'live' check; each allocates a closure per frame; server processes get HUD windows
kept.detail: These six are identical: arena 100, glare 51, netgraph 187, ping 66, revive 198, transition 149. Each is pcall(function() return api.is_active() and (coop_mode.decides_world() or api.is_live()) end), so it allocates a closure on every actor_on_update. markers 124 is an algebraically equal but convoluted form. coop_ui.session_live 379 is another copy. core_hud 73 differs: it reads the engine role api.is_player directly instead of the facade coop_mode.actor_is_player(). ping alone gates its window on coop_mode.actor_is_player() (730). transition/revive/arena/glare/netgraph create their HUD windows on any process that decides the world, including a world server whose actor is a ghost (coop_mode header: actor_is_player false there).
kept.fix: Put one function in coop_hud_kit: local function live_now() ... end; function live() local ok, on = pcall(live_now) ... end (no per-call closure). Gate window creation on coop_mode.actor_is_player() as ping does, and replace api.is_player in core_hud with the facade.
kept.correction: Removing the per-frame closure from the shared live() is fine and does not change behaviour. The six bodies are the same (arena 102, glare 53, netgraph 189, ping 68, revive 200, transition 151; coop_ui 382; markers 124-127 is algebraically equal). Gating window creation on coop_mode.actor_is_player() does change behaviour, so the flag false is wrong. On a world server, coop_hud_transition's Frame is the code that sends on_before_level_changing for trips (fade_for_the_go 853-860, 'the world server's scripts hear it now'). Without the window that callback stops there. Either keep the transition window on deciders, or first move that callback out of the HUD (it is itself world logic inside a HUD frame). Swapping api.is_player for the facade in core_hud 73-80 is safe only if coop_mode.actor_is_player answers the same on every role (not verified).

kept.title: 14 translate helpers with four different behaviours
kept.detail: tr/T copies: allies_map 63, compass 116, netgraph 76, arena 74, revive 253, transition 167, debug_ui 96, game_settings_view 80, loot_claim 422, main_menu 33, menu_char 141, menu 68 (exported), coop_ui T 41, economy_core 133. Their behaviour differs. compass and netgraph return nil when no fallback is given, while others return the id. Some treat "" as missing and some don't. menu, main_menu and coop_ui fill %s by gsub, the others use string.format via fmt. coop_main_menu.tr (33-45) is byte-identical to coop_menu.tr (68-80), while coop_menu_char.tr (141-149) already delegates to coop_menu.tr.
kept.fix: One tr(id, fallback) and one trs(id, ...) (the %s filler) in coop_ui_kit (or coop_menu_kit for menus), with HUD/economy using them. coop_main_menu uses coop_menu.tr as menu_char does. Keep each caller's fallback argument so the texts stay the same.

kept.title: About ten copies of 'load a script module by name'; one copy with the same name does not load
kept.detail: These are the same rawget + pcall(_G[name]) + type check: coop_economy_core.mod 123, coop_ui.mod_of 397, coop_menu.module_of 249, coop_menu_char.module_of 125, coop_game_settings_view.mod 88, coop_hud_arena.module_of 81, coop_trade_window.module_of 122 (+ inventory() 117), coop_hud_transition.markers_module 1030, coop_hud_markers.game_module 137 (caches absence). coop_hud_markers.module_of 130 has the same name but is only rawget (does not load), so the name says something it does not do.
kept.fix: Use coop_economy_core.mod (or one helper in coop_main) everywhere. Rename markers' version to loaded(name), or drop it.

kept.title: Per-frame allocations in HUD frames
kept.detail: These allocate every frame while in a session. transition Frame: metrics() table (871, defined 619), feed_events returns a new {} (879 -> 455), my_peer closure (175). revive Frame: metrics() table (671). glare: two new vector2 per visible lamp (232-233), and line 260 replaces self.glares with a new table on every frame while the HUD is hidden. core_hud Animate/Beat: { A.state_color("down") } for every down row and every row under 30% HP (896, 928) and per dying row (856), plus "coop_h3_pulse_" .. frame string per pulse (865). Every put() in core_hud, revive and transition builds a fresh vector2 (vec2: 524/322/497); compass and ping reuse one (compass 473, ping 532). compass DrawScale allocates letter_on = {} whenever the heading changes (700), although its header (28) says 'nothing is created in a frame'. The whole HUD costs 0.205 ms per frame (vault, stand 2026-11-13), so this is about GC churn and tidiness, not FPS.
kept.fix: Cache metrics per resolution (compare device().width/height). Return a shared empty table from feed_events. Reuse one vector2 per window. Compute the red colour once per Refresh in Fill (r.red). Precompute PULSE_TEX[0..7]. Keep letter_on as a field cleared in place. In glare, clear the table only when it is not already empty.

kept.title: Distance labels are re-formatted and re-translated every frame
kept.detail: compass DrawMarkers calls format_distance(dist) for every labelled marker each frame (917). ping does the same for every live ping (595). Both go through coop_allies_map.fmt_dist (187-191), which runs string_format, a pcall of game.translate_string for 'm'/'km', and two concatenations per call. Then TextWidth looks the string up in a 400-entry cache that it wipes when full (639).
kept.fix: Translate the unit strings once per window (or on language change). In the slot state, keep the last rounded distance (integer metres, tens, or 0.1 km) and call fmt_dist only when it changes. The text drawn stays identical.

kept.title: The other-players view is built 3-4 times over at different rates
kept.detail: views(tg) (254-293) calls api.players, the coop_mode.where/hook calls per player, object lookups, character_icon and two position reads per player (280 and 284). It is built by markers src_allies every 100 ms (coop_hud_markers 319), update_spots every 200 ms (1114), shared_views every 500 ms (301-309, the panel) and coop_hud_tc every 250 ms (coop_hud_tc 167): about 21 builds a second. shared_views was added exactly so that every window reads one list (comment 295-298).
kept.fix: Give shared_views a max_age argument. Markers (100 ms), spots and TC read shared_views(tg, max_age) and the panel keeps fresh = true. Read the position once per player in views.

kept.title: Stale comment: set_revive 'nothing calls it yet'
kept.detail: Lines 503-505 say 'Nothing calls it yet (the engine export coop.revive_progress comes with part 2)'. coop_hud_revive.script:301-316 (feed_panel) calls core.set_revive on every percent of the revive fill, and its header (28) says so.

kept.title: Section comment lists a 'walking while open' setting that does not exist
kept.detail: Line 1683: 'Settings popover (title bar): opacity, blur, density, walking while open, confirmations, reset'. The header (12-13) says 'There is no setting for walking', line 552 forces AllowMovement(false), and DEFAULTS (63-64) has no such key.

kept.title: Legacy alias self.cards and the old field name r.strip

Line 586 already sets self.team_panel = true for exactly that purpose ('how status lines and tests tell this window from the chat feed'). The bracket widget is still called r.strip with comment '(older name: strip)' (618, used 678-680, 936; tests test_allies.lua:440,466 and test_hud_v2.lua:1110).

kept.title: Exported functions nobody calls
