kept.title: Lua tests: two shared check() functions and about 50 private copies, each file printing its own summary
kept.detail: Global check is defined in support/stubs.lua:246 and again in support/harness_npc.lua:7. 50 test files define `local function check(`, 28 keep their own PASS/FAIL counters, and 273 print their own 'N passed, M failed' line in varying formats (test_allies.lua:655 '== %d passed', test_binders.lua:459 'W10 / F2 T11 client binders stub run: ...'). run_all.lua:57-70 then has to parse all of them.
kept.fix: One tests/lua/support/t.lua with check/eq/near/report, loaded by stubs and harnesses. Tests call t.report() and the driver reads a single fixed line.

kept.title: Native network tests bind 162 fixed UDP ports, so parallel runs collide
kept.detail: 162 hard-coded ports (Node x("..", 37210), .port = 27961, ...) in 17 test files; some ports are reused across tests (37290 x2, 38225 x3). There is no free-port helper in test_util.h. build_tests.cmd:4 tells parallel agents to use their own COOP_TEST_OUT, so two coop_tests.exe can run at once and bind the same ports: random connect failures or cross-talk.
kept.fix: t::port(n) = base + n, with base from COOP_TEST_PORT_BASE or derived from the process id. Or bind port 0 and read the bound address back from ENet.

kept.title: Default outputs are shared, so concurrent runs overwrite each other's exe and result rows
kept.detail: build_tests.cmd:52 deletes and rebuilds temp/tests/coop_tests.exe. run_all.lua:12 writes temp\lua\out\<name>.txt and reads it back to judge, so a concurrent run with the default folder can make a file be judged from another run's output. test_luajit writes temp/tests_luajit. Safety depends on every agent remembering COOP_TEST_OUT / COOP_LUA_OUT. test_lua.cmd already solved this for its own build (a private b_<random> folder, :86-95).
kept.fix: Default to a per-run folder (temp/tests/run_<random>, temp/lua/out_<random>) and keep a 'last' copy or link for people. The env vars still override.

kept.title: Static checkers that guard generated files are run by no runner
kept.detail: list_exports.py --check (:30-36) verifies that tests/lua_exports.txt matches the sources, and test_calls.cpp:38 reads that file, so a stale list keeps test_calls green. check_actor_compare.py, check_spawn_classes.py, cleanroom_check.py and check_font_atlas.py are likewise run only by hand: a grep of tools/*.cmd|*.ps1 finds no caller. Only check_layers is wired into G.
kept.fix: One tools/check_static.py (or extend G) that runs check_layers, list_exports --check, check_actor_compare, check_spawn_classes and check_font_atlas once, called by run_all_tests and release verify.
kept.correction: Half wrong. list_exports.py --check is already run on every native test run: tests/test_calls.cpp:464-479 (calls_export_list_is_live) runs it with _popen and requires ' 0 problem(s)'. So a stale tests/lua_exports.txt fails N rather than keeping test_calls green. check_actor_compare runs against the real tree only under pytest (tests/tools/test_actor_compare.py:42 and :49-50), which T does not run. check_spawn_classes, cleanroom_check and check_font_atlas are run by hand only; tests merely mention them in comments, for example test_initial_rules.cpp:181. Narrow the fix to wiring those three, plus check_actor_compare, into T or G.

kept.title: MODES.md §10 contradicts the runners
kept.detail: The SC row (:680) lists carry, base, sil, squads, sp_smoke, companions and cover, but stand_hostplay.ps1:28-29 also runs vehicle_group and progress_group. The SS row (:681) ends at feed_server, but stand_srv.ps1:34-35 also runs vehicle_server and progress_server. The T row (:678) says 'N и L', but run_all_tests.cmd also runs test_luajit (:36) and the move-wiring pytest (:42), and `--tests-mark write` runs tests/test_story_worldstate.py (check_gates.py:802). :699 states a dated count ('Сегодня (до S4) Ядро достигает 37 из 38 серверных файлов'). DEBUG_DESIGN.md:671 names tools/lua_exports.txt, but the file is tests/lua_exports.txt.
kept.fix: Have the doc point to check_gates.SCENARIOS (or generate the two rows from it) instead of repeating the lists. List exactly what T runs. Remove the dated state line. Fix the path in DEBUG_DESIGN.md.

kept.title: stand_server.ps1 and stand_srv.ps1: nearly the same name, different jobs
kept.detail: stand_server.ps1 prepares fsgame_server.ltx and appdata_server on a stand (:1-3). stand_srv.ps1 is the Server stand runner that writes srv.ok. Docs (DEDICATED_HOST.md:122, MODES.md:415) and split_test.ps1:19 have to explain which is which.
kept.fix: Rename stand_server.ps1 to prepare_server_appdata.ps1, or make it the first step of stand_srv.ps1, and update the references.

kept.title: Stable publishing is split between a bash wrapper and release.py, with the checks repeated
kept.detail: publish_github.sh validates BUILD (:34-38) and OWNER/VISIBILITY (:39-40), calls release.py verify, checks RayLink-Engine main ancestry and pushes the private launcher source. release.py already does verify/draft/publish for both channels and its own name and owner checks (names_for, ORG). That is two languages and two places for one release.
kept.fix: Fold the engine-main ancestry check and the launcher-source push into release.py (a stable-only step) and delete publish_github.sh with its fake-runner tests (test_release.py:992-1090).

kept.title: No pytest configuration: no markers, no test paths, and caches piling up
kept.detail: There is no pytest.ini/pyproject/setup.cfg at the root (root listing). tests/tools/.pytest_cache and __pycache__ hold files for both 3.13 and 3.14. There are no markers to pick the fast tool tests, the native slices or the PowerShell tests. run_all_tests.cmd:42 is the only Python call without -I (`python -B -m pytest`), unlike every other tool call.
kept.fix: pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options]: testpaths=['tests/tools'], addopts='-p no:cacheprovider', markers native/powershell/slow; add pytest-xdist to the dev requirements; use `python -I -m pytest` in the runner.

kept.title: check_layers.py is a 2998-line file mixing a C++ scanner, a Lua scanner, the model, rules and reach; its allow-list code is copied
kept.detail: Sections: rule patterns :214, inputs :373, source text :499, C++ scopes :623-982, Lua functions :982-1055, sources :1055, model :1464, srv load :1738, scan :2018, reach (used by check_gates) :2630, main :2836; 89 functions. check_actor_compare.py has its own parse_allow (:128), format_allow (:144) and scan (:115) for the same allow-list-with-ceiling format as check_layers (:458, :2862).

kept.title: A test reads untracked temp/b56 notes and silently skips without them
kept.detail: test_published_b56_notes_pass (:162-166) reads ROOT/temp/b56/notes-*.md and calls pytest.skip when they are missing, which is the case on any fresh checkout or on the new build host. A test of local scratch files proves nothing.

kept.title: Native slice scripts in tests/ are argparse programs with fixed or agent-named scratch folders
kept.detail: test_survival_s6_paths.py:15 writes into a fixed temp/A-S6-E-surv2b (an agent unit id), so parallel runs collide. test_s6_hub_paths.py:104, test_s6_npc_paths.py:100 and test_story_worldstate.py:62 make temp/A-S6-E-*-<uuid>. kept.detail: Root files: MODLOG.md (130 KB journal), REVIEW_2026-10-20.md, REVIEW_FINDINGS.md, W4_LUA_PORT.md, W5_INTEGRATION.md. These are October snapshots and reports. The owner's rule is that history belongs in git and the vault, not beside the rules files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, TZ.md).

Move those four to the existing docs/archive/ and update their references in docs/plans/2026-10-22-f0-stabilization.md, docs/plans/2026-10-22-f2-mod-layer.md and docs/archive/TZ_v1.md.

lua-adapters.summary: Слой адаптеров (46 файлов coop_mods_*, 22,2 тыс. строк) работает, но лишних вызовов в нём много, и часть из них идёт каждый кадр. Самое дорогое место: размещённые лампы Hideout Furniture. Каждое обновление биндера лампы шлёт по сети пакет hf_data, даже если ничего не поменялось (stock save_data вызывается на каждом update). Ещё три горячие точки: радиоактивная вода (луч и запись в pstor каждый кадр у каждого игрока), npc_on_update на каждого NPC ради миражей NTA и повторный поиск шлема по всему рюкзаку каждый кадр после загрузки, если шлем на голове. Помимо этого 35 обработчиков actor_on_update из адаптеров каждый кадр по отдельности проходят обёртку маршрутизатора. Нашлись и ошибки. Опрос «оживления» в ядре ложно срабатывает при лечении с почти нулевого здоровья, хотя движок давно шлёт coop_actor_revived. Реплику «товарища ранили» слышат все игроки на карте, а не только хозяин компаньона. Статистика wpo_holder вообще не попадает в coop_status. Мёртвый код: половина coop_mods_mags (Mags Redux) и ветки Experience Framework и zzz_wounded_heal_anim — этих модов нет в профиле G.A.M.M.A. Мёртвые и запасные пути «для старого exe», хотя exe и скрипты ставятся вместе. Красоте мешают три вещи. Первая — копии одних и тех же помощников: 34 обёртки C(), около 25 функций start_step, 15 проверок id с разными границами, 6 pack. Вторая — один мод разбросан по нескольким файлам (AGDD, ZCP, 3DSS, WPO, PBA), адаптеры подменяют наш же код (coop_main.on_event, coop_mods_pdata.apply_loaded в пять слоёв), а файлы items и misc держат по 12–13 модов. Третья — история в комментариях (Dev 57, build 56, даты, раунды ревью). Почти все правки не меняют того, что видит игрок. Исключения отмечены как ошибки: ложное оживление, реплика всем игрокам и пропавшая статистика.

kept.title: HF lamp publishes hf_data over the network on every binder update
kept.detail: The stock placeable_light_wrapper:update calls self:save_data() at the end of every update (temp/review/corpus/merged/bind_light_furniture.script:195, save_data at :223 -> hf_obj_manager.update_data). Our update_data wrap (coop_mods_hf.script:402-409) runs host_publish_data(id) every time (334-353): get_data (se_load_var), C().ser, hid, harv check, then C().publish("hf_data"). There is no change check, so an unlit lamp sends an identical payload every tick and a lit one sends a 1e-6 fuel step. In Server mode the world server deserializes it and relays to_all (422-432). Every receiver runs client_data (371-395): deser, then delete and update (two se_save_var), then wrapper_fuel. Estimate: N lamps x binder update rate (the scheduler tick, up to every frame) = network messages per second on the host. The radio (1778-1797) and the cat (coop_mods_hf_sounds.script:76-83) dedupe their payloads; the lamp does not.
kept.fix: In host_publish_data keep the last serialized payload per id and return when it is the same (this alone removes all traffic for unlit lamps and world lamps). For a change in the condition field alone, publish at most once per second or when the change is at least 0.001; publish at once when is_on or is_frozen changes. delete_data still publishes at once.

kept.title: Helmet retry scans the whole rucksack every frame while the chosen helmet is worn or gone
kept.detail: own_helmet (156-166) looks for the chosen helmet only through iterate_ruck and sets pending = chosen > 0 and not found. restore sets pending = chosen > 0 after a load (175). retry runs on actor_on_update forever (204-206) and calls own_helmet every frame while pending. In the stock mod lastHelmet stays the helmet you wear (liz_fdda_redone_headgear_animations_hotkey.script:111), so after a save or transition with the helmet on, the worn helmet is in slot 12 and not in the rucksack, and pending never clears until the player toggles it off. A sold or destroyed helmet keeps pending set for good. Cost per frame: a full rucksack iteration (GAMMA 100-300 items), setter(nil) (which also clears the mod's lastHelmet) and C().active().
kept.fix: In own_helmet also accept db.actor:item_in_slot(12) with that id. Clear pending when the id has no ALife object. Throttle retry to about 1 s and unregister the actor_on_update callback while nothing is pending (register it again in restore).
kept.correction: Right cost, wrong kind, and the fix can be simpler. Kind is hotpath, not bug: nothing the player sees goes wrong. iterate_ruck walks only inventory().m_ruck (engine script_game_object_inventory_owner.cpp:290-294), so a worn helmet (slot 12) keeps pending true after a load (coop_mods_misc.script:156-166, 175, 202-206). The callback also never returns true when it finds the helmet, so it always walks the whole rucksack. The per-frame retry adds nothing observable: in a session the toggle_helmet wrapper calls own_helmet() before the original (186), and on_save_state saves 'chosen' (198-200). The mod's other reader of lastHelmet is its own toggle and save. So keep retry on actor_on_first_update only, or throttle it to 1 s, and drop the actor_on_update registration. Accepting item_in_slot(12) is also fine: in stock a toggle while wearing sets lastHelmet = current anyway (liz_fdda_redone_headgear_animations_hotkey.script:109-111). 'Clear pending when the id has no ALife object' does not cover a sold helmet, which still has an ALife object at the trader. behaviour_change=false holds.

kept.title: Radioactive water: ray query, two vector allocations and a pstor write every frame for every player
kept.detail: In a session the actor_on_update wrap (93-115) does three things every frame: save_var(actor, "grw_in_water", nil) (99, a pstor write per frame), allocates two vectors, and calls level.pick_material (100-103). It does this even while standing still and on maps where get_damage_ms() is 0. The stock script (temp/anomaly_unpack/scripts_out/scripts/gameplay_radioactive_water.script) probes on footstep only and reads a flag per frame. clear_water() already clears the flag at load (76-80, on_load).
kept.fix: Drop the per-frame save_var. Keep two module-level vectors. Cache the in-water result and probe again only when the actor has moved more than about 0.2 m since the last probe. The hit stays per frame with delta, as in stock.

kept.title: Weapon-rider admission wraps coop_main.on_event: every event pays for it, economy batches are decoded twice
kept.detail: C().wrap(coop_main, "on_event") sends every incoming coop event through dispatch_riders (238): C() + api.is_active() + two string compares. For economy.se and economy.imd (up to 2000 entries per batch) it decodes the payload (248), loops with "k"..i, "i"..i, "d"..i and "x"..i string concatenations, re-encodes when it drops an entry (297), and then the economy handler decodes it again (coop_economy_mdata on_se:481 and on_imd:703 receive a decoded t). This is first-party code patched from an adapter.
kept.fix: Give coop_economy_mdata an admission hook that runs on the already decoded table before on_se/on_imd (e.g. em.admit(event, t, from) -> drop list). Move dispatch_riders into that hook and delete the on_event wrap.

kept.title: Two RF-target protocols; the radio adapter wraps coop_quests_core.send and coop_main.on_event to undo the old one
kept.detail: coop_quests_party.script:864-901 (patch_rf) monkeypatches item_radio.add_target/clear_target and sends quests.rf; client_on_rf (889-901) writes ir.RF_targets. coop_mods_radio syncs the same table through mods.rf, rf_big and rf_host_diff every 2 s (rf_tick 483-503). install_rf_quests (420-457) then wraps qc.send to rewrite the old message and wraps coop_main.on_event to overwrite what the old receiver installed (446: 'the legacy receiver installed its incomplete copy'). Every add_target sends two messages, and every incoming event of the session goes through one more wrapper (C().active() + verb compare).
kept.fix: Delete patch_rf, client_on_rf and stats.rf from coop_quests_party, and both wraps in install_rf_quests. mods.rf stays the only path.
kept.correction: Right duplication, but the fix as written breaks Server mode. patch_rf (coop_quests_party.script:864-887) is the only producer of map-server RF changes. On a map server, qc.host_party() is true (coop_quests_core.script:70-76), add_target/clear_target call qc.send("rf"), and the radio's qc.send wrapper (coop_mods_radio.script:423-435) calls rf_queue_map_target (300-308). That is the only writer of rf.changes (306), which rf_publish_changes sends to the world server as rf_target (247-256, 489-491). If patch_rf and both wraps are deleted, RF targets added by quest code on a map server never reach the world. Correct fix: in coop_mods_radio, wrap item_radio.add_target and clear_target once. On a map server, queue rf.changes there. On the deciding process, mark the diff due (or keep the 2 s rf_host_diff). Then delete patch_rf, client_on_rf, stats.rf, the qc.send wrap and the coop_main.on_event wrap. In Co-op, dropping quests.rf moves clients from an immediate update to the 2 s diff (rf_tick 483-486). That is a small timing change; to keep it, trigger rf_host_diff at once from the new add_target hook. With the corrected fix, behaviour_change=false and risk medium.

kept.title: 'Squadmate hit' line is sent to every player on the map for any companion hit, without a throttle
kept.detail: on_npc_hit (181-193) runs on the level leader for any NPC with the info npcx_is_companion. It sends voice_fx_wound to every player whose where(peer) is here, and the host player also plays it (play_wound). In single player the line plays only for the actor's own companion (agdd_voiced_actor.script:756, is_actor_companion(db.actor, npc)); the adapter forces that predicate to false in a session (199-203). In a firefight every hit sends one message per player; only the voice cooldown on the receiver keeps the audio sane.
kept.fix: Find the companion's leader with coop_npc_companions.leader_of(npc) (as coop_mods_emission_cover.script:83-90 does) and send only to that peer. Throttle per companion to at least the 3500 ms voice cooldown.

kept.title: Revive fallback poll fires false 'actor_revived' events on heal-ups; the engine already reports revives
kept.detail: revive_poll (765-794) runs every frame (884-889) until the first engine revive sets revive.engine. It counts any heal from health < 0.03 to >= 0.1 after more than 1 s as a revive; the comment admits that healing up counts too. The engine fires coop_actor_revived (engine coop_survival.cpp:974, coop_script.cpp:648), and the Lua script and the exe ship together. The listener coop_mods_misc bhs_on_revived (769-791) then clears the BHS concussion and lifts head/torso, so a medkit used at about 2% health ends a concussion.
kept.fix: Delete revive_poll, revive.by_poll, low_since and the 3 s poll/engine dedupe in engine_revived (756-762). Keep on_actor_revived as the engine entry point.
kept.correction: Valid cleanup and a real but narrower false trigger. revive_poll fires only when health jumps from <0.03 to >=0.1 within one frame: low_since is cleared on the first frame with h >= 0.03, and h >= 0.1 is tested only on that frame (coop_mods_core.script:774-783). A heal that takes effect over time (a booster) passes through 0.03-0.1 and does not trigger it. Triggers in practice are an instant-heal item, or a respawn on the same actor from dead (health 0 to 1). The poll stays on all session until the first engine revive (770). When it fires, bhs_on_revived clears the BHS concussion unconditionally (coop_mods_misc.script:760-771). The engine reports revives (coop_survival.cpp:974 -> coop_script.cpp:648). Its event queue is 1024 entries and drops the oldest only on overflow (coop_script.cpp:113, 602-617), and the poll cannot cover that case anyway because it stops after the first engine revive. Fix as proposed. behaviour_change=true (false triggers stop); confidence likely.

kept.title: npc_on_update for every NPC on every update, for the whole session, only to sample Mirage clones
kept.detail: If tasks_mirage exists, install_mirage registers npc_on_update for the whole session (482-484). Every NPC update then goes through the route wrapper, C().active() and leads_here, and calls mi.is_mirage(npc). Each mirage clone also runs, every update, sample_mirage (419-439): C().mod lookup, nu.actor_on_level, mirage_player, two str_explode table allocations of visual names (428) and alife_object. With 50-100 online NPCs that is 50-100 extra Lua calls per frame for a task that is almost never running.
kept.fix: Register npc_on_update only while the Mirage task runs: in the spawn_mirages wrapper, and unregister when mirage_weapons empties or the task ends. Alternatively gate on a module flag set by spawn_mirages before any per-NPC work. Cache the visual base name per visual string.

kept.title: 35 adapter actor_on_update handlers each pay the route wrapper every frame
kept.detail: grep: 35 RegisterScriptCallback("actor_on_update") calls in coop_mods_*. Each one is wrapped by coop_route guard (coop_route.script:196-215): runs(d) and note(d), two engine calls, plus a pcall per handler on a client. Most handlers then make their own C().active() engine call and return early (throttled ticks: ammo 328, pdata_pda 296, hf 1400/1931, radio 903, sleep_tick 609...). That is about 100 engine crossings per frame before any useful work.
kept.fix: Add core.tick(tag, f, period_ms): the existing core actor_on_update (884-889) checks active() once and calls due ticks under pcall (core.report on error). Move adapter per-frame handlers to it. First confirm with coop.route.of that every coop_mods_* handler has the same domain ('coop_* scripts are view', nta:505).

kept.title: Mags Redux half of coop_mods_mags is dead in the G.A.M.M.A. profile; the file name hides the live WPO part
kept.detail: magazines.script and magazine_binder.script are neither in the enabled G.A.M.M.A. set (temp/review/corpus/merged, built from the '+' lines of the profile modlist, make_corpus.py:36) nor in stock Anomaly. The only reference is a stray mags_patches.script from '433- UDP-9 Carbine'. Lines 61-309 (data mirror, mg_* verbs, eject/unload/drop, vest check, carried_mags pdata key) never install. The live half is the Weapon Parts Overhaul strip/swap code (310-560), which belongs with coop_mods_item_state and coop_mods_wpo_holder.
kept.fix: Move the WPO strip/swap code into a WPO adapter file. Delete Mags Redux support, or keep it in its own coop_mods_mags_redux file if non-GAMMA mod lists are a supported target (owner's decision).

kept.title: One mod spread over several adapter files, wraps stacked in hidden order (P12)
kept.detail: AGDD Voiced Actor: misc:1160-1168 patches actor_speak_base by plain assignment, actor_voice:200-213 wraps the same function through core.wrap, and voice_fx:195-213 swaps the npc_on_hit_callback env. smr_loot.try_spawn is wrapped twice, items:993-1000 and misc:684-685, and the two are coupled through C().identity_obj() and misc's as_player roll (704-710). 3DSS: items:1252-1330 (native_silencer_state, called from xchg_3dss:303,335), xchg_3dss, pdata_gamma:52 and the guard. campfire_placeable: items:892-945 and travel_compat:26-41. alife_storage_manager.on_before_load_state is wrapped by pdata:429, pdata_actor:82 and pdata_pda:429. WPO: item_state, mags 310-560, wpo_holder, items 1018-1250. Which wrapper runs outermost depends on on_game_start order.
kept.fix: One adapter file per mod (coop_mods_agdd, coop_mods_zcp, coop_mods_3dss, coop_mods_wpo ...), each wrapping a function once, with the composition explicit inside that file. Keep the current wrap order and pin it in tests.

kept.title: Adapters monkeypatch first-party coop code instead of using an extension point
kept.detail: Adapters wrap our own modules: coop_main.on_event (item_state:1192, radio:438), coop_npc_players.on (voice_fx:92), coop_quests_core.send (radio:423), coop_economy_mdata.clone_export and after_clone (item_state:1233,1259), coop_mods_pdata.register_module (pdata_pda:403), and coop_mods_pdata.apply_loaded five layers deep (after_restore at pdata_gamma:91,101,120,159 plus pdata_pda:415). Every such call goes through stacked closures, and the owner module cannot see who changes its behaviour.
kept.fix: Give the owners explicit hooks and call them from the adapters: pdata.register(key, { restore = fn }) / pdata.on_loaded(fn); an economy admission and clone hook; a companion-order route hook in coop_npc_players. Then delete the wraps.

kept.title: 'local function C() return coop_mods_core end' in 34 files: 1909 extra calls with no stated reason
kept.detail: 34 files define C() (also X() x6, P() x4, qc() x1, pdata_actor:18 active(), m_data() in hf:52 and items:65). grep: 1909 C(). call sites, including hot wrappers (fdda device_binder.update 180, glowstick binder 256, presence darkness 106, process_artefacts). coop_mods_core is never replaced at run time; coop_mods_travel_compat.script:8 binds 'local C = coop_mods_core' directly and works. If the reason is test load order (tests set E.coop_mods_core before or after load_script), no comment says so.
kept.fix: Bind once at the top of each file: 'local core = coop_mods_core' (and xchg/pdata the same way), and fix test setup order where needed. If late binding is really needed, state the reason once in the core header.

kept.title: About 25 copies of the install-step helper with three log styles; printf copies bypass the core error counter
kept.detail: start_step or step is defined in hf:1948, items:1459, mags:586, misc:1215, nta:973, pdata:449, perks:445, radio:912, move_limits:197, travel_compat:321, trade_computer:310, hf_sounds:243, view_fixes:86, voice_fx:245, hf_toggles:58, mob_trade:132, world_views:395, start_guard:163, pdata_actor:189, presence_gamma:71, xchg_3dss:360, xchg_fdda:467, xchg_meat:460, perk_abilities:683, perk_dots:669, item_state:1379, fixes:423, dao_fx and speed. The log formats differ: '! [coop_mods_x] ... failed', '[coop-mods] [voice_fx]', '! [mob_trade]', or C().report. The printf copies never reach coop_mods_core stats.errors, so the coop_status error count misses install failures.
kept.fix: Add core.install(tag, what, f, ...) = pcall + core.report and use it everywhere.

kept.title: 15 local object-id validators with different contracts
kept.detail: Each adapter has its own copy, and the bounds differ. hf:103 and trade_computer:54 accept strings (tonumber); the others need a number. pdata_pda:23 and xchg:109 accept 0; presence_gamma:22, hf_toggles:5 and pdata_gamma:137 do not. Some return the id, others a boolean. Others: nta:612 (minimum argument), mob_trade:12, travel_compat:44/48, combat_fixes:19, world_views:29, hf_sounds:14/18, xchg_meat:26, view_fixes:9. coop_mods_xchg.wire_id (102-107) already does the wire case (range check + lid), but only the xchg_* files use it.
kept.fix: Add core.object_id(v, allow_zero) -> id|nil and core.wire_id(v) (range + lid), and replace the local copies.
kept.correction: Right duplication, but the single helper must keep two contracts that the proposal drops. (1) hf:103-106 and trade_computer:54-57 coerce with tonumber because the wire values they read can be strings, so core.object_id needs a coercing variant or the callers must tonumber first, or valid requests start failing. (2) pdata_pda:21-25 is not a plain validator: it is an always-on coop_trust.guard('pda_id', ...) that counts and drops, so replacing it must keep the guard call. Bounds also differ: allow 0 in pdata_pda and xchg valid_id (xchg.script:109-111), exclude 0 elsewhere. Any merge must keep each call site's bounds, or behaviour changes. coop_mods_xchg.wire_id (102-107) is already the shared wire form.

kept.title: Fallbacks for an exe without the export are dead: Lua and exe ship together
kept.detail: misc:22,529-551,1226: the mods.song protocol (to_all('song'), on_song, songs table) runs only when coop.instrument is missing, but the engine exports it (coop_script.cpp:2063). dao_fx:44-49,110-125: warn_no_engine, the keep_stock_local branch and st.no_engine for a missing coop.zone_path (exported at coop_objects.cpp:2470). mob_trade:58 and view_fixes:36 check type(api.talk_recent) (exported at coop_script.cpp:2065). hf:87 itself says 'mixed builds cannot connect'.
kept.fix: Delete these fallback branches and call the exports directly.

kept.title: Comments carry history (Dev 57 tags, build numbers, dates, review rounds) instead of the current rule
kept.detail: 'Dev 57 Gx-y' header lines appear 18 times (armor_trade:2, hf_sounds:2, item_state:2, pdata_actor:2, pdata_gamma:2, start_guard:1, trade_computer:3, travel_compat:2, upgrades:2, world_views:2, xchg_3dss:2, xchg_fdda:1, xchg_meat:2, perk_abilities:4, perk_dots:4, combat_fixes:2). Build numbers: ammo:4, speed:4, hf:11,87,688,968-976,1022-1023, misc:19,63, pdata:20,135, perks:372. Dates: 28 lines, e.g. misc:16,33,40,794,890,971,993,1056,1093, core:362,466,787, guard:41,62,268, xchg_meat:311,323. Review labels: 'round 4 (blocker 2 of the round 3 review) ... It used to pass' (hf:967-970), 'P99 (TZ §6.28)' (item_state:67,167,352,570,584,881,908; fixes:439), 'R32 W8.1' (hf:80-85), 'TZ R92' (wpo_holder:3,13). The misc header (6-41) also documents mods that are not adapted (wd_core).
kept.fix: Rewrite each comment as the current rule and its reason; move the history to git and the vault. Do it file by file together with the other cleanups.

kept.title: coop_mods_items (1492 lines, 12 mods) and coop_mods_misc (1247 lines, 13 mods) mix unrelated responsibilities
kept.detail: items covers glowsticks 69, Model Drop 276, Autolooter 407, Stash Overhaul 521, corpse loot 555, backpack 634, placeable campfire 892, deployable gun 945, box window and ZCP 967, disassembly 1018 and 3DSS silencer 1252. misc covers EF, QAW, Kill Tracker, NPE, FFT, prefs, guitar, sleep, ZCP, PAW, BHS, damage balancer, AGDD and Oleh footsteps (header 6-41). One mod's change touches a 1.2-1.5k-line file shared with 12 others.
kept.fix: Split into one file per mod (together with the merge of scattered mods in the 'one mod spread over several files' finding); keep the shared helpers in core.

kept.title: Diagnostics shipped as adapters and run every frame (speed log, health-drain probe)
kept.detail: coop_mods_speed is not an adapter: it is a build-54 speed diagnostic. It does pcall(step) every frame (91-94), and every 30 s it runs find_local over all of speed.script (58-60, a debug.getupvalue scan). misc drain_tick (1074-1087) is a 'health fell with no hit' probe from a single complaint: every frame it creates a pcall closure and reads health, and it counts hits through two callbacks (1091-1097).
kept.fix: Move both to the debug layer behind a debug toggle (coop_debug), or delete them. If they stay, cache the find_local holders and use core.tick at 1 s.

kept.title: Darkness anomaly: every anomaly binder is wrapped, and each darkness field rebuilds the players-on-map list every update
kept.detail: The wrap of anomaly_field_binder.update (104-113) applies to every anomaly on the map (DAO's per-update patch, drx_da_main.script:2812). For each zone_mine_darkness on the map leader it calls players_here(level.name()) every update (33-43). That allocates coop_npc_players.everyone() and, per player, calls seat_plays/where/standing and game_graph():vertex():level_id() -> alife():level_name. With k darkness fields and n players that is k list allocations and k*n graph lookups per frame. darkness_for (88-96) also allocates closures and env tables every update while a player is inside a field.
kept.fix: Build the leader's list of players on this map (with positions) once per frame and share it between binders (cache on time_global/frame), and do the distance check before anything else. Reuse one sim/env table per player.

kept.title: Dot Marks per-marker getters do an identity check on every call; the same check also runs every second
kept.detail: The wraps of dotmarks_main.is_invbox_found, is_invbox_searched and is_concealed_stash_marker (327-338) run in Dot Marks' marker loop for every container in range (ui_hud_dotmarks.script:527). Each call does C().active(), config(), and same_object, which costs object_id (coop_trust.guard), two pcall closures (online, object_name) and another coop_trust.guard. The same identity sweep already runs once a second (actor_on_update 296-300 validate_current) and in the validate_object_tables wrap (314-325).
kept.fix: Rely on the 1 s sweep and drop the per-call checks, or memoise the result per id for one second.

kept.title: coop_mods_fixes re-implements core helpers and patches without core.wrap
kept.detail: It has its own log (47-51), once, mod (59-62, no file-existence check, unlike core.mod), is_client (62-67, pcall around core.is_client) and module_local (90-100, the same as core.find_local). guard_guide (339-350), guard_relations (400-418) and guard_spairs (291-300) assign directly, so coop_status' 'wrapped' list does not show them. print_status (453) has no caller; its own comment at 440 says so. _stats and _installed (457-458) are test hooks with no comment.
kept.fix: Use the core helpers and core.wrap. Delete print_status and mark the test hooks. If the file must work before core loads (main menu), say so in its header; core has no world dependency.
kept.correction: Mostly right, two details wrong. (1) module_local (coop_mods_fixes.script:90-100) is not the same as core.find_local. It falls back to rawget(m, name), the module field, because G.A.M.M.A.'s unlocalizer turns tasks_guide's curr_guid into a module field (header V4, 26-30). It also walks only plain module functions, with no class methods and no one-wrapper-deep search. Switching to core.find_local must keep that fallback. (2) _stats and _installed (457-458) are not test hooks: neither scripts nor tests call them (only test_mods_fixes.lua and test_main_menu.lua load the file, and neither uses them), so they are dead code. print_status (453-455) has no caller, as its own comment at 439-440 says. The direct assignments in guard_guide and guard_relations bypass core.wrap's 'wrapped' list, as stated. The file is also loaded from coop_main_menu.script:518 before any world, but core has no world dependency, so using its helpers is fine.

kept.title: wpo_holder status never reaches coop_status
kept.detail: coop_status prints print_status only for coop_main STATUS_MODULES (coop_main.script:1348-1360); the only adapters in that list are coop_mods_core and coop_mods_actor_voice. wpo_holder defines print_status (191-195) but registers no core.status_line, so its counters (utils_item and utils_ui places, players priced, busted, errors) are never printed. There are two status mechanisms: status_line in most adapters, STATUS_MODULES print_status in actor_voice:253, which also uses printf instead of core.log.
kept.fix: Register wpo_holder (and actor_voice) through core.status_line and remove the second mechanism.

kept.title: One-shot and session-poll handlers keep running every frame
kept.detail: perks actor_on_update (436-441) returns on the 'rebound' flag after the first frame but stays registered forever (455). dao_fx (197-213) runs pcall(step) every frame only to notice a session start or end. items actor_on_update (1446-1454) has a first_done branch on clients. mags (563-569) has a 'first' block. nta late_install (948) is a one-shot inside the per-frame handler.
kept.fix: Use actor_on_first_update or UnregisterScriptCallback after the one-shot work. For dao_fx, react to the session start/stop callback, or use core.tick at 500-1000 ms.

kept.title: watch_routes builds the player list and a new table every frame on the world server
kept.detail: update (1123-1128) calls watch_routes every frame: a new 'now' table, C().players() (the engine builds a list of tables) and pcall(bridge_of) per player (532-546). parts_dirty = {} allocates a new table every frame even when nothing is dirty (1127).
kept.fix: Run watch_routes on a 500-1000 ms timer or on coop_world_back and level-change events, and reuse tables (swap only when next(parts_dirty)).

kept.title: Experience Framework branch targets a mod absent from G.A.M.M.A.
kept.detail: experience_core is neither in the enabled GAMMA set (temp/review/corpus/merged) nor in stock Anomaly. The dead parts are EF_SUBS (59), the registration (388-391) and the header (6-8). The header also documents a non-adapter (Wearable Devices, 9-10).
kept.fix: Delete it, or move it to a non-GAMMA adapter if other mod lists are supported. Move the 'not adapted' notes to docs/MOD_REPLACEMENTS.md.

kept.title: Wounded-heal animation hooks target zzz_wounded_heal_anim, which is not in G.A.M.M.A.
kept.detail: C().mod("zzz_wounded_heal_anim") is nil in GAMMA: only zzzz_wounded_heal_anim_dotmarks.script exists, and it is guarded on that module. The transfer_medkit wrap, the on_hud_animation_end wrap and the in_animation/animation_npc state (193-212) never install.
kept.fix: Delete it, or label it as support for non-GAMMA mod lists.

kept.title: Names that hide meaning: active() means three things, and there are three ways to get the engine table
kept.detail: core.active() means a session is on. ammo:65 active() means a live client with an actor. start_guard:15 active() returns the raw api.is_active(). pdata_actor:18 aliases it, and nta:39 has world_active. core.world_client (105-107) duplicates active()'s test inline. To get the engine table: core.engine() (126, an identity accessor, 25 uses), 'local api = rawget(_G, "coop")' (about 10 files), and a closure-wrapped _G read in hf:97.
kept.fix: Name by meaning (live_client_with_actor, session_on). Use one engine accessor, either the core local or 'local api = rawget(_G, "coop")' everywhere. world_client should call active().
kept.correction: Right idea, wrong counts and one wrong example. In coop_mods_* the engine table comes mostly from 'local api = rawget(_G, "coop")' (36 adapter files), and core.engine() (coop_mods_core.script:126-128) has only about 7 call sites in adapters, not 25. hf.script:97 reads _G.coop_trust inside a closure (the trust wrapper of finding 31), not the engine table, so it is not a third way to get it. The rest holds: ammo:65-68 active() = live client with an actor, start_guard:15-17 returns the raw api.is_active(), pdata_pda... pdata_actor:17 aliases core.active, nta:38 world_active, and core.world_client (105-107) repeats active()'s test inline. Use rawget(_G, "coop") everywhere (the majority form) and drop core.engine().

kept.title: Layer marker comment: Russian in 30 files, English variants in 3, missing in 13
kept.detail: 30 files start with '-- Ядро: без проверок режима (docs/MODES.md)'. start_guard:1 says 'Core: no mode checks', xchg_fdda:1 'Core, Dev 57', and pdata_pda has another variant. The layer is already decided by tools/layers.txt (check_gates.py), and no checker reads this line.
kept.fix: Drop the line, or use one English form that check_layers.py verifies.

kept.title: pack(), near() and m_data() copied across adapters with drifting defaults
kept.detail: pack is defined in guard:103, voice_fx:38, xchg_3dss:17, xchg_fdda:18 and xchg_repair:43, and misc:481 creates it as a new closure on every guitar call. near differs per copy: hf:48 defaults to NEAR, items:59 has no default (nil -> error), mags:41 defaults to 12; core.nearest_player is a fourth form. m_data() is in hf:52 and items:65.
kept.fix: Add core.pack and core.near(obj, who, dist) with one default, and call alife_storage_manager.get_state() directly.

kept.title: hf trust(): a fail-open wrapper around coop_trust.pass with a closure per check
kept.detail: trust (96-101, 16 call sites) creates a pcall closure to read _G.coop_trust, then calls pcall(t.pass). It returns true (lets the request through) if coop_trust is missing or errors. coop_trust ships with the mod, and pass already protects its own formatting (coop_trust.script:58-75). All other adapters call coop_trust.pass directly.
kept.fix: Call coop_trust.pass directly and delete the wrapper.

kept.title: Three error rethrows add this file's position to the mod's message
kept.detail: error(result) without level 0 at items:250 (glowstick animation end), combat_fixes:208 and pdata_pda:398 prefixes the adapter's file:line, so the report points at the adapter instead of the mod. The other 33 rethrows in coop_mods_* use error(e, 0).
kept.fix: Change the three calls to error(result, 0).

kept.title: rate_ok allocates a default limit table per message, and buckets are never pruned
kept.detail: limits[verb] or { 20, 10 } (394) allocates a table for every received message of a verb without set_limit. buckets['from:verb'] (395-401) is never cleared for departed peers, so it grows on a dedicated server running for days with many joins.
kept.fix: Use a module-level DEFAULT_LIMIT constant, and drop a peer's buckets when it leaves (players() diff or a disconnect callback).

kept.title: device_binder.update checks the engine before the cheap first_update flag
kept.detail: 'if C().active() and not self.first_update' (180) makes an engine call on every update of every device binder for the whole session, although the work is needed only before the first update.
kept.fix: Swap the order: 'if not self.first_update and C().active()'.

kept.title: Container-marker wrapper repeats the original's lookups and adds a pcall per container per tick
kept.detail: For every in-range container on each marker tick, the wrapper (368-391) calls hud.is_body_claimed and dots.init_inventory_box, which the original repeats (ui_hud_dotmarks.script:519-522), and then runs the original under pcall.
kept.fix: Do only the DOT_REFRESH_MS refresh in the wrapper, pass the box through, and call the original directly when no refresh is due.
kept.correction: Right duplication, wrong fix. The wrapper keeps 'reading = cache' set while the original runs (coop_mods_world_views.script:387-389) so that the get_inventory_table wrap (362-367) returns the cached observation. The comment at 360-361 says why: without it the mod reads unsearched empty stashes again and loses their stock 'unknown contents' prompt. Calling the original directly when no refresh is due leaves reading nil, so that re-read comes back, which is a behaviour change. Correct fix: keep reading set around every call of the original. Drop only the duplicate is_body_claimed and init_inventory_box work. The pcall can go only if reading is still cleared on error. The saving is two table lookups per container per tick: payoff low, behaviour_change=false for the corrected fix.

kept.title: Unused global alias _vec and uncommented test hooks
kept.detail: '_vec = vec' (593) has no user in scripts or tests. misc:1100 _fresh_count and fixes:457-458 _stats/_installed are test-only exports with no comment saying so.
kept.fix: Delete _vec, and mark the test hooks with one comment line or expose them through the status functions.
kept.correction: _vec is at coop_mods_core.script:592 (not 593) and has no user in scripts or tests: delete it. Hook status differs per export: misc _fresh_count (1100) is used by tests/lua/test_mods_respawn.lua:111, so mark it as a test hook. fixes _stats and _installed (457-458) have no caller in scripts or tests, so they are dead code, not test hooks: delete them (see finding 21).

kept.title: wrap() records only labels; no way to see which of the 233 wraps are hot in live play
kept.detail: wrap (162-171) appends the label to 'wrapped' and nothing else. The hot ones found by reading the code: binder updates (light, harvester, radio, cat, glowstick, device, anomaly field), npc_on_update (mirage), footstep proxy, dotmarks getters and marker loop, coop_main.on_event x2, process_artefacts, has_alife_info, task_status_functor xN, before-hit wraps. None of this is measured.
kept.fix: Behind the debug toggle, have wrap() put a call counter around the produced function and add a coop_status line with the top 20 labels by calls per second. Use it to confirm the order of these fixes on a stand.

refuted.why: Not a hot path in the G.A.M.M.A profile. thermal_helpers is cached on success (install_battery: 'battery = battery or thermal_helpers()', xchg_3dss.script:190). install_battery then sets installed.battery even before ui_inventory.GUI exists (198-209). The upvalue names it needs exist in the deployed z_3dss_thermal_battery and z_3dss_silencer_condition (e.g. condition_per_shot :359, write_state :80, silencer_wear_enabled :27). All three installers succeed on the first update, and afterwards update() (365-370) only tests three booleans. Retrying every frame would matter only after a hypothetical 3DSS rename, so this is a robustness nit, not a measured cost.

Not a hot path, and the described cost is wrong. Stock inventory_upgrades.save_state is one field assignment, 'm_data.RepairItemList = RepairItemList' (anomaly inventory_upgrades.script:58-61), so the wrapper's pcall into it costs one small table. has_repair_info runs only when a mechanic dialog evaluates its precondition. The nil-npc case is not new either: stock has_repair_info (101-103) calls npc:section() on the same dialogs.who_is_npc result without a check.

Not a hot path. first_roll runs only under C().identity_obj() (items.script:999), that is, once per container a client opens when misc rolls it with as_player (misc.script:705-710). It does not run on every try_spawn on the host or in single player. upvalue() stops at the first nil upvalue (coop_mods_core.script:185-188), so the loop does not run up to 255 times per function. One find_local walk per box opened is negligible. Caching only holder and index is correct (smr_loot reassigns boxes in load_state, smr_loot.script:377), but that is a tidy-up with no measurable effect.

The costs are negligible, and one claim is wrong. The spairs guard adds one Lua call to functions that sort the table they iterate, and is_client() is evaluated only for t == nil (coop_mods_fixes.script:276-278). The alife_release replacement is not active outside a session: watch_releases is called only after ammo's active(), which is live_client() and db.actor (coop_mods_ammo.script:65-68, 328-331, 339-342). It is one call per release, which is rare. The servo proxy costs one __index call per exo NPC footstep (voice_fx.script:226-236). None of these is a hot path. Installing and restoring on session start and end would add state and risk for no measurable FPS.
